Hollow Serenity#000.src: A cold touch shivers down your spine...

Hollow Serenity#001.src: There's a book sticking out of here with the number '{~}' drawn on it...
Hollow Serenity#001.dst: 여기 책 한 권이 튀어나와 있고, 그 위에 '{~}'이라는 숫자가 적혀 있다...

Hollow Serenity#003.src: It's a touching story... but you don't read it. It's not nice to ignore someone who's looking at you.
Hollow Serenity#003.dst: 감동적인 이야기다... 하지만 읽지는 않는다. 누군가 보고 있는데 모른 척하는 건 예의가 아니니까.

Hollow Serenity#004.src: The drawer is sealed with a tight rope. Something sharp should be able to cut it.
Hollow Serenity#004.dst: 서랍이 단단히 묶인 끈으로 봉해져 있다. 날카로운 것이 있으면 끊을 수 있을 것 같다.

Hollow Serenity#005.src: You begin to read the letters inside of the drawer...

Hollow Serenity#006.src: Eileen, Eileen... That girl never listens to me! Her own mother!
Hollow Serenity#006.dst: Eileen, Eileen... 그 아이는 내 말을 도통 듣지 않아! 제 친어미 말인데!

Hollow Serenity#007.src: Every day, I find books sticking out of the bookshelves! And she keeps on coloring random letters in them...
Hollow Serenity#007.dst: 날마다 책장에서 책이 반쯤 빠져 있는 걸 발견해! 게다가 그 안에 아무 글자나 색을 칠해 놓질 않나...

Hollow Serenity#008.src: She told me that those are her favorite books, there's some sort of 'clue' in them for... something.
Hollow Serenity#008.dst: 그 아이는 그게 자기가 가장 좋아하는 책들이고, 안에 뭔가의 '단서'가 들어 있다고 하더군.

Hollow Serenity#009.src: I can't comprehend her reasons for doing that... Can't she come up with something that's less of a nuisance for the maids?
Hollow Serenity#009.dst: 왜 그러는 건지 도무지 이해가 안 돼... 하녀들에게 덜 번거로운 방법을 생각해 낼 수는 없는 걸까?

Hollow Serenity#010.src: "Dwarves vs. Doguns: The Final Flame" - Daarin Thundershield
Hollow Serenity#010.dst: 『드워프 대 Dogun: 마지막 불꽃』 - Daarin Thundershield

Hollow Serenity#011.src: It's a grossly overexaggerated novel about the {p} war.

Hollow Serenity#012.src: The chest is tightly locked. The lock itself appears to require a combination of four letters, all in a specific order...
Hollow Serenity#012.dst: 상자가 단단히 잠겨 있다. 자물쇠 자체가 글자 넷을 정해진 순서대로 맞춰야 하는 것 같다...

Hollow Serenity#013.src: ...You don't have the slightest clue as to what the passcode could be.

Hollow Serenity#015.src: It's apparently about a boy who's scared by the sound of an owl hooting.
Hollow Serenity#015.dst: 부엉이 울음소리에 겁을 먹은 소년에 대한 이야기인 듯하다.

Hollow Serenity#016.src: This appears to be a letter explaining who the Faltachs are...
Hollow Serenity#016.dst: Faltach 가문이 어떤 사람들인지 설명하는 편지인 듯하다...

Hollow Serenity#017.src: According to the text, the Faltachs are a family of nobles that have been apart of the forest for decades, more or less having personal control over the area.
Hollow Serenity#017.dst: 글에 따르면 Faltach 가문은 수십 년째 이 숲에 자리를 잡은 귀족 가문이며, 이 일대를 사실상 사유지처럼 장악해 왔다.

Hollow Serenity#018.src: They collected taxes from residents of the forest, and were an integral part of the region's politics... But considering the state of this manor, that isn't the case anymore.
Hollow Serenity#018.dst: 그들은 숲의 주민들에게 세금을 걷었고, 이 지역 정치에서 빠질 수 없는 축이었다... 하지만 이 저택의 상태를 보면, 이미 그렇지 않다.

Hollow Serenity#019.src: As of {~} AP, The family consisted of Yorman Faltach, Katarin Faltach, and their infant daughter Eileen.
Hollow Serenity#019.dst: {~} AP 기준으로 이 가문은 Yorman Faltach, Katarin Faltach, 그리고 아직 젖먹이인 딸 Eileen으로 이루어져 있었다.

Hollow Serenity#020.src: One of the books pops out quite glaringly. You decide to check it out...
Hollow Serenity#020.dst: 책 한 권이 유난히 튀어나와 있다. 살펴보기로 한다...

Hollow Serenity#022.src: It's a book detailing one of the greatest board games of all time. It sounds quite fun.
Hollow Serenity#022.dst: 역사상 가장 위대한 보드게임 중 하나를 자세히 다룬 책이다. 꽤 재미있어 보인다.

Hollow Serenity#023.src: The door is locked. A key is required.

Hollow Serenity#024.src: "The Elephelk And The Skyraider" - Clifford Stein

Hollow Serenity#026.src: It's a pile of charred letters... You can still make out some of the words, though.
Hollow Serenity#026.dst: 불에 그슬린 편지 더미다... 그래도 몇몇 단어는 알아볼 수 있다.

Hollow Serenity#027.src: G-r---... I cannot ignore it --- longer...
Hollow Serenity#027.dst: G-r---... 더 이상 --- 무시할 수 없어...

Hollow Serenity#028.src: ...love you too much... -- tired of Yorman...

Hollow Serenity#029.src: ... doesn't have to know. We can — happy together... y--r's truly, -----in...
Hollow Serenity#029.dst: ... 알 필요는 없어. 우리는 — 함께 행복할 수 있어... 영원한 당신의, -----in...

Hollow Serenity#030.src: What brings you here today, human?
Hollow Serenity#030.dst: 오늘은 무슨 바람이 불어서 왔나, 인간?
Hollow Serenity#030.speaker:
Rohem
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Hollow Serenity#031.src: Pick the third letter of the passcode:

Hollow Serenity#032.src: That was incorrect, despite the fact that the last letter was obviously R... It looks like you need to start over again.
Hollow Serenity#032.dst: 틀렸다. 마지막 글자가 분명히 R인데도... 처음부터 다시 해야 할 것 같다.

Hollow Serenity#033.src: It's an old letter. The edges are stained with some strange, dark liquid...
Hollow Serenity#033.dst: 오래된 편지다. 모서리에 뭔가 이상한 검은 액체가 번져 있다...

Hollow Serenity#035.src: Garvan... he worries me more and more by the day. My sweet, beloved Garvan.
Hollow Serenity#035.dst: Garvan... 그는 날이 갈수록 나를 걱정시킨다. 내 다정하고 사랑하는 Garvan.

Hollow Serenity#036.src: I remember, at the beginning... Yorman had hired Garvan out of concern for this 'Decay' plaguing the land. We told him that he must find a cure for the Decay before it subjugated the entire forest.
Hollow Serenity#036.dst: 기억한다, 처음에는... Yorman이 이 땅을 괴롭히는 '쇠락'을 걱정해 Garvan을 고용했다. 우리는 쇠락이 숲 전체를 집어삼키기 전에 치료법을 찾아야 한다고 그에게 말했다.

Hollow Serenity#037.src: Over time... Well, I suppose love can corrupt. How else would I have...
Hollow Serenity#037.dst: 시간이 지나며... 사랑도 사람을 타락시키는 모양이다. 그렇지 않다면 내가 어찌...

Hollow Serenity#038.src: Fallen in love with Garvan and forsook my own marriage under the nose of my husband and my beloved daughter-
Hollow Serenity#038.dst: Garvan을 사랑하게 되어, 남편과 사랑하는 딸의 눈앞에서 내 혼인을 버렸을까—

Hollow Serenity#039.src: But I digress. Garvan's done great research on this Decay, but... recently, he's changed. Something's wrong with him.
Hollow Serenity#039.dst: 그러나 말이 샜다. Garvan은 이 쇠락에 대해 훌륭한 연구를 해냈지만... 요즘 그는 변했다. 어딘가 잘못되었다.

Hollow Serenity#040.src: His eyes are glazed and dull. His tone of voice is... disturbing. He's made very little progress on the cure we tasked him with, and... I don't know what to do.
Hollow Serenity#040.dst: 그의 눈빛은 흐리고 생기가 없다. 말투는... 불안하다. 우리가 맡긴 치료법에는 거의 진척이 없고, 그리고... 나는 어찌해야 할지 모른다.

Hollow Serenity#041.src: I suppose... I should just leave him be for the time being. Surely me butting into his work would just make him even worse, no?
Hollow Serenity#041.dst: 아마도... 당장은 그를 내버려 두는 게 좋겠다. 내가 그의 일에 끼어들면 더 나빠질 뿐이지 않을까?

Hollow Serenity#042.src: Besides, if he ever gets too bad, he lives just east of the manor. I can be there for him if I need to, right?
Hollow Serenity#042.dst: 게다가 정말로 심해지면, 그는 저택 바로 동쪽에 산다. 필요하면 가서 곁에 있어 줄 수 있잖아?

Hollow Serenity#043.src: That was... unsettling. Nevertheless, you should head east of the manor for any sign of where this Garvan person might live. You recall there being a village around there...
Hollow Serenity#043.dst: 저건... 꺼림직했다. 어쨌든 저택 동쪽으로 가서 이 Garvan이라는 사람이 어디 사는지 단서를 찾아보는 게 좋겠다. 그 근처에 마을이 있었던 기억이 난다...

Hollow Serenity#044.src: ...That was odd. Who was that? ...Regardless, you shouldn't stray away from heading to the village.
Hollow Serenity#044.dst: ...이상했다. 그건 누구였을까? ...아무튼 마을로 가는 길에서 벗어나지 않는 게 좋겠다.

Hollow Serenity#045.src: He isn't here, though. I don't know his whereabouts, what he's doing, or if he's even alive. He's... just nonexistent.
Hollow Serenity#045.dst: 하지만 여기엔 없네. 어디 있는지, 뭘 하는지, 살아는 있는지도 몰라. 그는... 그냥 없는 사람이야.
Hollow Serenity#045.speaker:
Old Man
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Hollow Serenity#046.src: I don't know why you're chasing after him, but... if you want a place to start, go look at the abandoned laboratory on top of that hill, just to the west of here.
Hollow Serenity#046.dst: 왜 그를 쫓는지는 모르겠지만... 시작할 곳을 원한다면 여기서 바로 서쪽, 언덕 위의 버려진 실험실을 살펴보게.
Hollow Serenity#046.speaker:
Old Man
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Hollow Serenity#047.src: I'm Bip! Yeah, Bip! The best guy to ever grace the entertainment industry!
Hollow Serenity#047.dst: 난 Bip이야! 그래, Bip! 연예계를 빛낸 최고의 사나이지!
Hollow Serenity#047.speaker:
Bip
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Hollow Serenity#048.src: Or... I was... Man, I miss my glory days! I used to be a big time man, you know? I was living it up in {p}, but now I have to live in this dump!
Hollow Serenity#048.dst: 아... 난 예전에... 아, 화려했던 시절이 그립다! 나 한때 거물이었거든? {p}에서 떵떵거리며 살았는데 이제 이런 촌구석에 살아야 해!

Hollow Serenity#049.src: ...You know what? Neither do you! You've said, like, {~} sentences in the past {~} minutes!
Hollow Serenity#049.speaker:
Runo
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Hollow Serenity#050.src: Hello, soldier! Welcome to this... hick village. I presume the neighbor's kid has been stealing apples again, hmm?
Hollow Serenity#050.dst: 안녕하세요, 병사님! 이... 시골 마을에 오신 걸 환영해요. 옆집 애가 또 사과를 훔쳤나 보죠?
Hollow Serenity#050.speaker:
Ann
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Hollow Serenity#051.src: Oh, Ann... Your voice is so delicate, so soothing that— Ah, soldier! Are you here for something... or someone?
Hollow Serenity#051.dst: 오, Ann... 당신 목소리는 참 섬세하고 포근해서- 아, 병사님! 뭘... 아니면 누굴 찾으러 오셨나요?
Hollow Serenity#051.speaker:
Ann
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Hollow Serenity#052.src: Absolutely we're married! Everyone finds it very hard to believe, but I don't blame them! It's a tough world... we... live in, yes!
Hollow Serenity#052.dst: 당연히 결혼했죠! 다들 잘 안 믿지만 탓하진 않아요! 우리가 사는 건 험한 세... 상이... 니까요, 네!
Hollow Serenity#052.speaker:
Ann
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Hollow Serenity#053.src: Four years it has been, ever since we kissed under the starry sky amidst the blossoming fields near {p}. I can still see it in my dreams...
Hollow Serenity#053.dst: {p} 근처 꽃 핀 들판, 별이 가득한 하늘 아래서 입맞춘 지 4년이 흘렀죠. 아직도 꿈에서 그날이 보여요...
Hollow Serenity#053.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#055.src: You know the massive prison near {p}? Yeah, the {p}.
Hollow Serenity#055.dst: {p} 근처의 그 거대한 감옥 알지? 그래, {p} 말이야.
Hollow Serenity#055.speaker:
Vera
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

similar.text: You know the massive prison near {p}? Yeah, the {p} Penitentiary.

Hollow Serenity#056.src: What do the others call me? Uhh... Big-nosed girl. Yeah, I know, a bit on the nose-
Hollow Serenity#056.dst: 다른 사람들이 날 뭐라고 부르냐고? 어... 코쟁이. 그래, 알아, 코 얘기라니 너무 대놓고–

Hollow Serenity#057.src: What should you call me? Hmm... I don't know... maybe... Eua?
Hollow Serenity#057.dst: 뭐라고 부르면 되냐고? 음... 글쎄... 어쩌면... Eua?
Hollow Serenity#057.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#059.src: I've been hired by Yorman and Katarin Faltach to study and hopefully cure this "Decay" that's appeared recently. I'm quite excited to get to the bottom of this.
Hollow Serenity#059.dst: Yorman과 Katarin Faltach가 최근 나타난 이 "쇠락"을 연구하고, 가능하면 치료하도록 나를 고용했다. 끝까지 파헤칠 생각에 꽤 설렌다.

Hollow Serenity#060.src: It looks like I'm finally settled in. The Faltach Family has been quite kind with giving me this laboratory to study in.
Hollow Serenity#060.dst: 드디어 자리를 잡은 듯하다. Faltach 가문은 이 실험실을 연구용으로 내주는 친절을 보여 주었다.

Hollow Serenity#061.src: Where to start... where to start...

Hollow Serenity#062.src: This Decay is interesting, to say the least. I've never seen anything like this before in all my years.
Hollow Serenity#062.dst: 이 쇠락은, 좋게 말해도 흥미롭다. 평생 이런 것은 본 적이 없다.

Hollow Serenity#063.src: Simple plant life appears to wither even when given proper nutrients and conditions to grow. What little magic they usually contain appears to be sapped as well...
Hollow Serenity#063.dst: 적절한 양분과 환경을 주어도 단순한 식물은 시들어 가는 듯하다. 본래 품고 있던 얼마 안 되는 마력마저 빨려 나가는 것 같다...

Hollow Serenity#064.src: It's odd. the Decay doesn't violently alter whatever it touches, like a pestilence would... It appears to be removing something in a coordinated manner. Almost as if a living creature was doing this.
Hollow Serenity#064.dst: 이상하다. 쇠락은 역병처럼 닿은 것을 거칠게 바꿔 놓지 않는다... 무언가를 질서 있게 덜어내는 것처럼 보인다. 마치 살아 있는 생물이 하고 있는 것처럼.

Hollow Serenity#065.src: But what organism could be removing magic from the plant?
Hollow Serenity#065.dst: 하지만 어떤 생물이 식물에서 마력을 뽑아낼 수 있단 말인가?

Hollow Serenity#066.src: Eheheheheheeh... I've found it. I've found it I've found it I've found it I've found it I've found it I've found it I've found it
Hollow Serenity#066.dst: 헤헤헤헤헤헤... 찾았다. 찾았다 찾았다 찾았다 찾았다 찾았다 찾았다 찾았다

Hollow Serenity#067.src: Throughout the forest, especially in caves, one can find strange, parasitic creatures that specialize in living underneath the earth.
Hollow Serenity#067.dst: 이 숲 곳곳, 특히 동굴에서는 땅속에서 사는 데 특화된 기묘한 기생 생물을 찾을 수 있다.

Hollow Serenity#068.src: When I touched one of these creatures after capturing it... It was as if my skin began to shrivel. It... siphoned energy from my hand.
Hollow Serenity#068.dst: 그중 하나를 잡아서 만져 보았더니... 피부가 쪼그라드는 듯한 느낌이었다. 그것은... 내 손에서 기운을 빨아갔다.

Hollow Serenity#069.src: I gave the thing access to a few fresh plants from the {p}, and watched with awe. Within a few minutes, it rendered the plant into a state identical to that of Decay-afflicted life.
Hollow Serenity#069.dst: 그 생물에게 {p}에서 따온 싱싱한 식물 몇 포기를 주고, 경이로움에 차서 지켜보았다. 몇 분 만에 식물은 쇠락에 걸린 생명과 똑같은 상태가 되었다.

Hollow Serenity#070.src: I was right. I was right I was right I was right I was right I was right.
Hollow Serenity#070.dst: 내가 옳았다. 내가 옳았다 내가 옳았다 내가 옳았다 내가 옳았다 내가 옳았다.

Hollow Serenity#071.src: These parasites are what are causing the Decay. This is no otherworldly force or pestilence, no. This is an assault created solely by magical creatures. I... should thank my new friends for this discovery.
Hollow Serenity#071.dst: 이 기생 생물들이 바로 쇠락의 원인이다. 이것은 이계의 힘도 역병도 아니다, 아니야. 이것은 오직 마법 생물들이 일으킨 공격이다. 나는... 이 발견에 대해 새 친구들에게 감사해야겠다.

Hollow Serenity#073.src: I've decided to try and talk a little more with the villagers just down the hill. They're quite interesting...
Hollow Serenity#073.dst: 언덕 아래 마을 사람들과 좀 더 이야기해 보기로 했다. 그들은 꽤 흥미롭다...

Hollow Serenity#074.src: It's odd, though... Most of them keep glaring at me every time I return from my business in {p}. This one farmer kept asking me what my thoughts on the Gerten War and the government's involvement with it...
Hollow Serenity#074.dst: 그런데 이상하다... {p}에서 일을 보고 돌아올 때마다 대부분이 나를 노려본다. 어느 농부는 Gerten 전쟁과 그에 대한 정부의 개입을 어찌 생각하느냐고 계속 물었다...

Hollow Serenity#075.src: I just explained that I was a scientist researching the effects of the Decay. I might have lied a little and said I was almost about to find a cure. One of them seemed interested in that...
Hollow Serenity#075.dst: 나는 쇠락의 영향을 연구하는 과학자라고만 설명했다. 조금 거짓을 섞어 치료법을 거의 찾았다고도 말했다. 그중 한 사람이 그 말에 관심을 보인 듯했다...

Hollow Serenity#076.src: I went to the secret study inside of the Faltach's basement to look at some texts about the war and the government out of curiosity. I believe those people were just freaks. I should stay away from them-
Hollow Serenity#076.dst: 호기심에 Faltach 가의 지하에 있는 비밀 서재에 가서 그 전쟁과 정부에 관한 글을 몇 편 읽었다. 그 사람들은 그저 괴짜라고 생각한다. 가까이하지 않는 게 좋겠다—

Hollow Serenity#077.src: The rest of the page as well as the next few pages have had their contents furiously crossed out.
Hollow Serenity#077.dst: 이 쪽의 나머지와 다음 몇 쪽의 내용은 거칠게 지워져 있다.

Hollow Serenity#078.src: Huh huh huh huh huh huh huh huh huh huh huh huh huh huh huh huh huh huh huh huh huh huh huh huh huh huh huh huh huh huh huh huh huh huh?
Hollow Serenity#078.dst: 하 하 하 하 하 하 하 하 하 하 하 하 하 하 하 하 하 하 하 하 하 하 하 하 하 하 하 하 하 하 하 하 하 하?

Hollow Serenity#079.src: What lies. Lies lies lies lies lies lies lies lies lies lies. I don't really mind those people.
Hollow Serenity#079.dst: 거짓말이다. 거짓말 거짓말 거짓말 거짓말 거짓말 거짓말 거짓말 거짓말 거짓말 거짓말. 나는 그 사람들이 딱히 싫지 않다.

Hollow Serenity#080.src: I quite like them. Yes. Yes yes yes yes yes. They're trustworthy. I should have believed them from the start.
Hollow Serenity#080.dst: 오히려 꽤 좋다. 그렇다. 그렇다 그렇다 그렇다 그렇다 그렇다. 믿을 만하다. 처음부터 믿어야 했다.

Hollow Serenity#082.src: ...Whatever made that scream, it... sounds like it's getting closer to the laboratory-
Hollow Serenity#082.dst: ...그 비명을 지른 게 무엇이든, 그것은... 실험실로 다가오고 있는 듯하다—

Hollow Serenity#083.src: Find somewhere to hide in the laboratory. Now.
Hollow Serenity#083.dst: 실험실 안에서 숨을 곳을 찾아라. 당장.

Hollow Serenity#084.src: It looks like that figure left. It should be safe to leave.
Hollow Serenity#084.dst: 그 그림자는 떠난 듯하다. 이제 나가도 안전할 것이다.

Hollow Serenity#085.src: ... That journal mentioned a secret study hidden away in the manor's basement. It might be worth checking out for more clues.
Hollow Serenity#085.dst: ... 그 일지에 저택 지하에 숨겨진 비밀 서재가 있다고 적혀 있었다. 단서를 더 찾으러 가 볼 만하다.

Hollow Serenity#086.src: Well, it's a clock. Some of its components appear to be missing, though.
Hollow Serenity#086.dst: 음, 시계다. 다만 부품 몇 개가 없는 듯하다.

Hollow Serenity#087.src: They must be around here somewhere. Maybe if you can find them, you'll be able to use the clock.
Hollow Serenity#087.dst: 분명 이 근처 어딘가에 있을 것이다. 찾아내면 이 시계를 쓸 수 있을지도 모른다.

Hollow Serenity#088.src: There's some sort of riddle etched onto the door's surface...
Hollow Serenity#088.dst: 문 표면에 어떤 수수께끼가 새겨져 있다...

Hollow Serenity#089.src: "You died at {~} o-clock that night. Only {~} people came to your funeral.
Hollow Serenity#089.dst: "너는 그날 밤 {~1}시에 죽었다. 장례식에 온 사람은 {~2}명뿐이었다.

Hollow Serenity#090.src: {~} of them couldn't have cared less. The other person wept for {~} hours afterwards."
Hollow Serenity#090.dst: 그중 {~1}명은 조금도 신경 쓰지 않았다. 남은 한 사람은 그 뒤 {~2}시간을 울었다."

Hollow Serenity#091.src: It's a small notes page that Garvan appeared to have written...
Hollow Serenity#091.dst: Garvan이 쓴 듯한 짧은 메모 한 장이다...

Hollow Serenity#092.src: Hmmm... Odd. There's a lot to take in here relating to Gavel's deceased monarchy. It's quite interesting, though there is nothing about the Gerten War.
Hollow Serenity#092.dst: 흐음... 이상하다. Gavel의 사라진 왕실에 관한 내용이 많아 소화할 거리가 적지 않다. 꽤 흥미롭지만 Gerten 전쟁에 대한 것은 하나도 없다.

Hollow Serenity#093.src: There are a few philosophical books that dive deep into the divide that the Cinfrasian Uprising has caused within the province. Very... strong opinions indeed.
Hollow Serenity#093.dst: Cinfras 사람들의 봉기가 이 지방 안에 만든 분열을 깊이 파고든 철학서가 몇 권 있다. 의견이 참... 대단히 강하다.

Hollow Serenity#094.src: The Decay has certainly drowned out that conflict. I myself have never heard of any of this! Though again, I never was a lover of history in the first place.
Hollow Serenity#094.dst: 쇠락이 그 갈등을 확실히 덮어 버렸다. 나 자신도 이런 이야기는 들어 본 적이 없다! 하기야 애초에 역사를 좋아한 적도 없다.

Hollow Serenity#095.src: Huh. One of the more recent books suggests something has resurfaced in Kander. Villagers are ordered to keep an eye on their neighbors...
Hollow Serenity#095.dst: 흠. 비교적 최근의 책 하나는 Kander에서 무언가가 다시 드러났다고 암시한다. 주민들은 이웃을 감시하라는 명을 받았다...

Hollow Serenity#096.src: I should ask Katarin about this. She'd likely know more than I about any remaining royal politics, no?
Hollow Serenity#096.dst: 이 일은 Katarin에게 물어봐야겠다. 남아 있는 왕실 정치에 대해서는 나보다 잘 알 테니까.

Hollow Serenity#097.src: It's an excerpt from Yorman's Journal...

Hollow Serenity#098.src: ...What the hell is my wife THINKING?? Defending Garvan, as much of a lunatic as he is??
Hollow Serenity#098.dst: ...내 아내는 대체 무슨 생각인가?? 저런 미치광이 Garvan을 변호하다니??

Hollow Serenity#099.src: The man's made so little progress in the past few years. At this point, it's just a waste of our wealth...
Hollow Serenity#099.dst: 그 사내는 지난 몇 해 동안 진척이 거의 없었다. 이쯤 되면 우리 재산을 낭비하는 것일 뿐이다...

Hollow Serenity#100.src: Why is she defending HIM?? She's always been like that, so hopeful and defensive of the scientist... what could she POSSIBLY see in him?
Hollow Serenity#100.dst: 왜 그를 변호하는가?? 늘 그랬다, 그 과학자에게 기대를 걸고 감싸고... 대체 그에게서 무엇을 본 것인가?

Hollow Serenity#101.src: Unless... No. That is impossible. She is not... like that. Damn it, I might be in the need for some well-deserved sleep...
Hollow Serenity#101.dst: 설마... 아니다. 그럴 수는 없다. 그녀는... 그런 사람이 아니다. 젠장, 나도 제대로 잠을 좀 자야 할지 모르겠다...

Hollow Serenity#102.src: Upon closer inspection, this bookshelf actually appears to be a false panel. You can see a room behind it, as well.
Hollow Serenity#102.dst: 자세히 보니 이 책장은 사실 가짜 판자인 듯하다. 뒤에 방이 하나 보이기도 한다.

Hollow Serenity#103.src: It's more clear. Day by day. This pestilence. Clear. Clear.
Hollow Serenity#103.dst: 점점 분명해진다. 날마다. 이 역병. 분명하다. 분명하다.

Hollow Serenity#104.src: The creatures that cause this... and their wellspring... are sent by something beyond my comprehension.
Hollow Serenity#104.dst: 이를 일으키는 생물들... 그리고 그 근원은... 내 이해를 넘어선 무엇이 보낸 것이다.

Hollow Serenity#105.src: Yes. Yes yes yes yes yes yes yes yes yes yes yes yes yes yes yes yes. The Decay has been... brought here by divine intervention.
Hollow Serenity#105.dst: 그렇다. 그렇다 그렇다 그렇다 그렇다 그렇다 그렇다 그렇다 그렇다 그렇다 그렇다 그렇다 그렇다 그렇다 그렇다 그렇다 그렇다. 쇠락은... 신의 개입으로 이곳에 온 것이다.

Hollow Serenity#106.src: Then... I will use the divine's sentries to cure this. Just as they suggested.
Hollow Serenity#106.dst: 그렇다면... 나는 신의 파수꾼을 써서 이것을 치료하겠다. 그들이 제안한 그대로.

Hollow Serenity#107.src: I will begin at my research outpost in that stone city of {p}. I'll bring her there.
Hollow Serenity#107.dst: 저 돌의 도시 {p}에 있는 내 연구 전초기지에서 시작하겠다. 그녀를 거기로 데려가겠다.

Hollow Serenity#108.src: And all of this will finally end. By a cure.
Hollow Serenity#108.dst: 그러면 이 모든 것이 마침내 끝난다. 치료법으로.

Hollow Serenity#109.src: So there's a research outpost in what you assume is now Old {p}...? It might be worth it to go investigate that outpost for anything useful.
Hollow Serenity#109.dst: 그러니 지금은 옛 {p}이라 불릴 그곳에 연구 전초기지가 있다는 뜻인가...? 쓸 만한 것이 있을지 그 전초기지를 조사해 볼 가치가 있겠다.

Hollow Serenity#110.src: ...It seems that the exit has been opened up.

Hollow Serenity#111.src: This apparition before you isn't doing anything, though. Maybe you could try talking to it?
Hollow Serenity#111.dst: 다만 눈앞의 이 환영은 아무것도 하지 않는다. 말을 걸어 보면 어떨까?

Hollow Serenity#112.src: That spirit didn't open the door? Then... what did? Or... who did?
Hollow Serenity#112.dst: 문을 연 것이 저 영혼이 아니라면... 무엇이 열었을까? 아니면... 누가?

Hollow Serenity#113.src: You need to leave the study.

Hollow Serenity#114.src: As you fall deeper into unconsciousness, a vision of the past begins to form in your mind...
Hollow Serenity#114.dst: 의식이 더 깊이 가라앉으면서, 과거의 환상이 머릿속에 떠오르기 시작한다...

Hollow Serenity#115.src: Woman, have you SEEN the state that cretin is in?? Even if it does take long, he's in no damn shape to deal with it! Now stop arguing with me, and help me get rid of him--
Hollow Serenity#115.dst: 부인, 그 얼간이 꼴을 봤소?? 오래 걸리는 건 그렇다 쳐도 그 상태론 감당도 못 해! 이제 그만 따지고 그놈 치우는 걸 도우시오-
Hollow Serenity#115.speaker:
Katarin Faltach
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Hollow Serenity#116.src: Fine. But know this; I will see to it MYSELF that his head is taken off of his shoulders if that man continues to waste my time, understand??
Hollow Serenity#116.dst: 좋소. 하지만 명심하시오. 그자가 계속 내 시간을 낭비하면, 그 목이 어깨에서 떨어지는 걸 내가 직접 보고 말 거요, 알겠소??
Hollow Serenity#116.speaker:
Katarin Faltach
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Hollow Serenity#117.src: I-I am here, Katarin. You wished to s-speak with me...?
Hollow Serenity#117.dst: 와, 왔습니다, Katarin. 저와 이, 이야기하고 싶으셨다고요...?
Hollow Serenity#117.speaker:
Katarin Faltach
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Hollow Serenity#118.src: Yes, love. Yorman is becoming suspicious of you. He thinks that you're not making any progress on the cure and wasting his time. Any more of this, and he may attempt to get rid of you.
Hollow Serenity#118.dst: 네, 여보. Yorman이 당신을 의심하기 시작했어요. 치료제에 진척도 없이 자기 시간만 낭비한다고 생각해요. 이대로면 당신을 없애려 할지도 몰라요.
Hollow Serenity#118.speaker:
Katarin Faltach
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Hollow Serenity#119.src: F-Fine. I am fine. I appreciate the concern, but... It truly is u-unwarranted. I'm q-quite close to finding a cure to this disease, y-yes.
Hollow Serenity#119.dst: 괘, 괜찮습니다. 괜찮아요. 걱정은 고맙지만... 정말 부, 불필요합니다. 병의 치료제를 거, 거의 찾았어요, 네.
Hollow Serenity#119.speaker:
Katarin Faltach
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Hollow Serenity#120.src: Wonderful. And... is our eternal bond safe? The gemstone? Has... Yorman found about it?
Hollow Serenity#120.dst: 다행입니다. 그리고... 우리의 영원한 인연은 안전합니까? 그 보석 말입니다. Yorman이... 알아챘나요?
Hollow Serenity#120.speaker:
Katarin Faltach
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Hollow Serenity#121.src: We... I will not risk her life for our love. She has a future in {p}, Garvan! She isn't a part of this and I don't think she—
Hollow Serenity#121.dst: 우리... 난 우리 사랑 때문에 그 애 목숨을 걸진 않을 거예요. 그 애는 {p}에서 미래가 있어요, Garvan! 이 일과는 상관없고, 그 애가-
Hollow Serenity#121.speaker:
Katarin Faltach
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Hollow Serenity#122.src: Do you realize, Katarin? Our daughter is a gift from the heavens! Once she has matured, she will accomplish things that Gavel has never seen! Bring back the holy and royal will that was los-
Hollow Serenity#122.dst: 알겠습니까, Katarin? 우리 딸은 하늘이 내린 선물입니다! 자라면 Gavel이 본 적 없는 일을 해낼 겁니다! 잃어버린 신성과 왕가를 되찾고-
Hollow Serenity#122.speaker:
Katarin Faltach
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Hollow Serenity#123.src: Unbeknownst to the Faltach family, Yorman's hunch was correct all along. Their hired scientist had indeed moved away from his original goal.
Hollow Serenity#123.dst: Faltach 가문은 몰랐지만, Yorman의 직감은 처음부터 옳았다. 그들이 고용한 과학자는 정말로 본래의 목표에서 멀어져 있었다.

Hollow Serenity#124.src: During his research, Garvan had come too close into contact with the forest villagers... and was thoroughly broken into subservience.
Hollow Serenity#124.dst: 연구를 하는 동안 Garvan은 숲의 주민들과 너무 가까이 지내게 되었고... 철저히 꺾여 순종하게 되었다.

Hollow Serenity#125.src: Their goals were unclear, but they seemed uninterested in having Garvan continue to truly cure the Decay. Instead, they suggested something far more sinister.
Hollow Serenity#125.dst: 그들의 목적은 분명하지 않았으나, Garvan이 쇠락을 진짜로 치료하도록 두는 데에는 관심이 없어 보였다. 대신 그들은 훨씬 더 음흉한 것을 제안했다.

Hollow Serenity#126.src: It seems like someone brought you back to the forest village. You should probably head to Garvan's research outpost in Old {p}.
Hollow Serenity#126.dst: 누군가 너를 숲 마을로 데려온 듯하다. 옛 {p}에 있는 Garvan의 연구 전초기지로 가는 게 좋겠다.

Hollow Serenity#127.src: In order to progress, you must gather pieces of evidence that are surrounded by green particles. You can do this by right-clicking on them.
Hollow Serenity#127.dst: 진행하려면 초록색 입자로 둘러싸인 증거들을 모아야 한다. 우클릭으로 모을 수 있다.

Hollow Serenity#128.src: Occasionally a wandering intruder will approach the outpost, and will catch you if it sees you. You will have to hide by right-clicking the closets covered in blue particles.
Hollow Serenity#128.dst: 이따금 떠도는 침입자가 전초기지로 다가오며, 너를 보면 붙잡는다. 파란 입자로 덮인 옷장을 우클릭해 숨어야 한다.

Hollow Serenity#129.src: You managed to gather all of the evidence in the research outpost! You should review the material you gathered and figure out what Garvan was up to.
Hollow Serenity#129.dst: 연구 전초기지의 증거를 모두 모았다! 모은 자료를 다시 살펴보고 Garvan이 무엇을 꾸미고 있었는지 알아내야 한다.

Hollow Serenity#130.src: As you begin to sift through your findings, a visualization of what you're reading forms in your mind...
Hollow Serenity#130.dst: 찾아낸 것들을 훑어보기 시작하자, 읽고 있는 내용이 머릿속에 그림으로 떠오른다...

Hollow Serenity#131.src: Ah... N-now you're finally here. I... need you, my darling. We— no... I can cure this Decay with you.
Hollow Serenity#131.dst: 아... 드, 드디어 왔구나. 난... 네가 필요하단다, 얘야. 우리- 아니... 너와 함께라면 이 쇠락을 치료할 수 있어.
Hollow Serenity#131.speaker:
Strange Parasite
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Hollow Serenity#132.src: W-What do you mean...? I-I don't like this... I-I w-wanna go home. It's getting late and mother—
Hollow Serenity#132.dst: 무, 무슨 말이에요...? 이, 이거 싫어요... 지, 집에 가, 갈래요. 늦었고 엄마가-
Hollow Serenity#132.speaker:
Strange Parasite
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Hollow Serenity#133.src: Hello, my love. I-I-It's... been a while.
Hollow Serenity#133.speaker:
Katarin
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Hollow Serenity#134.src: W-Well... I-I've done... I've... done Eileen a great service... she will live forever, just as we do. Thanks to what I have done.
Hollow Serenity#134.dst: 그, 그러니까... 제, 제가... Eileen에게... 큰 은혜를 베풀었어요... 그 애는 우리처럼 영원히 살 겁니다. 제가 한 일 덕분에요.
Hollow Serenity#134.speaker:
Katarin
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Hollow Serenity#135.src: Y-you... Bound her soul?? Garvan no, I told you she wasn't part of this!! WHY??
Hollow Serenity#135.dst: 다, 당신... 그 애 영혼을 묶었어요?? Garvan, 안 돼, 그 애는 상관없다고 했잖아요!! 왜??
Hollow Serenity#135.speaker:
Katarin
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Hollow Serenity#136.src: It doesn't matter. You've accomplished what we planned for, and that is perfect. The girl will grow into a suitable leader... Now then, we have some questions for you.
Hollow Serenity#136.dst: 상관없다. 넌 우리가 계획한 일을 해냈고, 그거면 완벽하지. 그 소녀는 적합한 지도자로 자랄 거다... 자, 그럼 몇 가지 묻겠다.
Hollow Serenity#136.speaker:
Garvan
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Hollow Serenity#137.src: Now then... You will tell us where the rightful heir to the Gavellian throne is... No matter the cost.
Hollow Serenity#137.dst: 자 그럼... 왕좌의 정당한 후계자가 어디 있는지 말하게 될 거다... 어떤 대가를 치르더라도.
Hollow Serenity#137.speaker:
Mysterious Leader
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Hollow Serenity#138.src: ...If Eileen was given eternal life, then... She's most likely still alive. You should check around the manor for any clues as to where she might be right now.
Hollow Serenity#138.dst: ...Eileen이 영원한 생명을 받았다면... 아마 아직 살아 있을 것이다. 지금 어디 있을지 단서를 찾아 저택 주변을 살펴봐야 한다.

Hollow Serenity#139.src: My sins... you did not need to see them... all the things that I've done wrong. H-How I destroyed the bonds tying me and my love together.
Hollow Serenity#139.dst: 내 죄... 넌 볼 필요 없어... 내가 저지른 모든 잘못을. 내, 내가 어떻게 나와 내 사랑을 잇던 인연을 부쉈는지.

Hollow Serenity#140.src: ...Y-Yes... I mean her. Katarin. She's watching us as we speak, no? A-and with that... I suppose it's obvious what lies under this veil.
Hollow Serenity#140.dst: ...그, 그래... 그녀 말이야. Katarin. 지금도 우릴 보고 있잖아? 그, 그렇다면 이 베일 아래 뭐가 있는지는 뻔하겠지.

Hollow Serenity#141.src: AAAAAAAGGGHHH!!! F-FINE! I-I'll tell you... I-I'll tell y-you where Eileen is...
Hollow Serenity#141.dst: 으아아아아아악!!!! 조, 좋아! 마, 말하지... Eileen이 어디 있는지 마, 말해 주지...

Hollow Serenity#142.src: ... Good. This had better not be a lie. You; tell the others that we are heading there now. Kill everyone at the manor and any witnesses; leave the heir alive.
Hollow Serenity#142.dst: ... 좋다. 거짓이 아니기를 바란다. 너는 다른 이들에게 지금 그곳으로 간다고 전하라. 저택의 모두와 목격자는 다 죽여라. 상속자만 살려 두어라.
Hollow Serenity#142.speaker:
Garvan
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Hollow Serenity#143.src: ... M-Mother... why d-do I have to stay here?
Hollow Serenity#143.dst: ... 어, 어머니... 왜 제가 여기 있어야 하나요?
Hollow Serenity#143.speaker:
Katarin
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Hollow Serenity#144.src: It's for your own good, dear. Now, remember to stay put. Garvan won't be able to use you if you're kept inside of here...
Hollow Serenity#144.dst: 다 널 위해서란다, 얘야. 자, 꼭 가만히 있어. 여기 안에 있으면 Garvan이 널 이용하지 못해...
Hollow Serenity#144.speaker:
Eileen
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Hollow Serenity#145.src: Yorman won't be bothering us anymore, sweetheart. He wouldn't understand, so... J-just don't worry about what happened to him. It's irrelevant-
Hollow Serenity#145.dst: Yorman은 더는 우릴 괴롭히지 않을 거야, 아가. 그이는 이해 못 했을 테니... 그, 그이가 어떻게 됐는지는 신경 쓰지 마. 중요하지 않아-
Hollow Serenity#145.speaker:
Eileen
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Hollow Serenity#146.src: L-LADY KATARIN! T-THERE ARE INTRUDERS— AAAAAAHHHHHH!!!
Hollow Serenity#146.dst: K, Katarin 마님! 치, 침입자가- 으아아아아악!!!
Hollow Serenity#146.speaker:
Katarin
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Hollow Serenity#147.src: ... Who the hell are you all?
Hollow Serenity#147.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#148.src: Step aside, Katarin Faltach. This will be much simpler if you stand down and tell us where your daughter is.
Hollow Serenity#148.dst: 비켜라, Katarin Faltach. 순순히 물러나서 딸이 어디 있는지 말하면 훨씬 간단해질 거다.
Hollow Serenity#148.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#149.src: GET AWAY FROM HER, DO YOU HEAR ME??? RAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAGGGGGGGGHHHHHHH!!!!
Hollow Serenity#149.dst: 그 애한테서 떨어져, 내 말 안 들려??? 으아아아아아아아아아아아악!!!!
Hollow Serenity#149.speaker:
Eileen
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Hollow Serenity#150.src: ... I should have known. I-I... my love... y-you're gone.
Hollow Serenity#150.dst: ... 알았어야 했다. 나, 나는... 내 사랑... 당, 당신은 떠났군.
Hollow Serenity#150.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#151.src: DAMN IT! DAMN IT DAMN IT DAMN IT DAMN IT AAAAAALLLL!!!!
Hollow Serenity#151.dst: 젠장! 젠장 젠장 젠장 젠장 다 젠장이다아아아아!!!!

Hollow Serenity#152.src: This is... W-why did this have to happen? ... I-I can't... this can't end like this...
Hollow Serenity#152.dst: 이건... 왜, 왜 이렇게 되어야 했나? ... 나, 나는 못 해... 이렇게 끝날 수는 없어...
Hollow Serenity#152.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#153.src: And so it ends here. At the same time, it begins my desperate attempts to flee from my past.
Hollow Serenity#153.dst: 그리하여 그것은 여기서 끝난다. 동시에, 내 과거에서 필사적으로 달아나려는 날들이 시작된다.

Hollow Serenity#154.src: I tried to forget. I tried to forget everything, even my own name. I ignored Katarin's spirit calling out to me, demanding I return to her.
Hollow Serenity#154.dst: 나는 잊으려 했다. 모든 것을, 내 이름까지도 잊으려 했다. 나를 부르며 돌아오라 요구하는 Katarin의 영혼을 외면했다.

Hollow Serenity#155.src: I became... nothing. A nobody. I had no purpose. I wandered the forest, pretending that nothing had ever gone wrong... Indeed, I had become a Wanderer.
Hollow Serenity#155.dst: 나는... 아무것도 아닌 존재가 되었다. 이름 없는 자. 목적이 없었다. 아무 일도 잘못된 적 없는 척하며 숲을 떠돌았다... 그렇게 나는 방랑자가 되었다.

Hollow Serenity#156.src: Have I not repented enough? Have I not suffered for decades in this god-forsaken forest?? And why did you have to-
Hollow Serenity#156.dst: 아직도 속죄가 부족한가? 이 신에게 버림받은 숲에서 수십 년을 고통받은 걸로 부족한가?? 그런데 왜 네가-
Hollow Serenity#156.speaker:
Garvan
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Hollow Serenity#157.src: It seems like Garvan went in the direction of the master bedroom...
Hollow Serenity#157.dst: Garvan은 주 침실 방향으로 간 듯하다...

Hollow Serenity#158.src: I... Yes, yes! P-Please, my love! I-I know I've spent the last century and a half running away from u-us, but...
Hollow Serenity#158.dst: 저... 네, 네! 제, 제발요, 여보! 지난 한 세기 반 동안 우, 우리에게서 도망쳐 온 건 알지만...
Hollow Serenity#158.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#159.src: I-I placed it in the catacombs, right next to where—
Hollow Serenity#159.dst: 지, 지하 묘지에 뒀어요, 바로 옆에-

Hollow Serenity#160.src: NO!! NO, NO NO NO NO!! HUMAN, H-HELP ME!! KATARIN... K-KATARIIIIINNNNN!!!!
Hollow Serenity#160.dst: 안 돼!! 안 돼 안 돼. 인간, 사, 살려 줘!! KATARIN... K-KATARIIIIINNNNN!!!!

Hollow Serenity#161.src: ...The catacombs! Katarin must have fled to the catacombs in the basement!
Hollow Serenity#161.dst: ...지하 묘실! Katarin은 분명 지하실의 묘실로 달아났을 것이다!

Hollow Serenity#162.src: Katarin seems furious. Does she not know exactly where the gemstone is?
Hollow Serenity#162.dst: Katarin은 격노한 듯하다. 보석이 정확히 어디 있는지 모르는 걸까?

Hollow Serenity#163.src: ... You know where it is. You need to show her where the gemstone is before she brings this room down on your head.
Hollow Serenity#163.dst: ... 너는 그것이 어디 있는지 안다. 그녀가 이 방을 네 머리 위로 무너뜨리기 전에 보석의 위치를 알려 줘야 한다.

Hollow Serenity#164.src: The gemstone must be underneath this rubble, right?
Hollow Serenity#164.speaker:
Katarin
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Hollow Serenity#165.src: You knew where it was— Hmm... what did Garvan call you things...?
Hollow Serenity#165.dst: 넌 어디 있는지 알았지- 흠... Garvan이 너희를 뭐라고 불렀더라...?

Hollow Serenity#166.src: Do you hear that? It's the ocean waves... The heavens... They're calling for me—
Hollow Serenity#166.dst: 들려? 파도 소리야... 하늘이... 날 부르고 있어-

Hollow Serenity#168.src: OUR LOVE WAS MEANT TO LAST FOREVER.

Hollow Serenity#169.src: INTRUDER. YOU MADE THE WRONG CHOICE.

Hollow Serenity#170.src: IF YOU REFUSE TO FORGIVE ME, THEN I WILL SIMPLY ERASE ANY PROOF THAT WE EVER EXISTED.
Hollow Serenity#170.dst: 네가 나를 용서하지 않겠다면, 나는 우리가 존재했다는 증거를 모두 지워 버리겠다.

Hollow Serenity#171.src: AND NOTHING WILL REMEMBER YOU ONCE YOU DISAPPEAR.
Hollow Serenity#171.dst: 그리고 네가 사라지면 아무것도 너를 기억하지 않을 것이다.

Hollow Serenity#178.src: Now, I'm... finally free. But... I suppose I still have unfinished business. Before I leave, I must know something.
Hollow Serenity#178.dst: 이제 난... 드디어 자유야. 하지만... 아직 끝내지 못한 일이 있나 봐. 떠나기 전에 알아야 할 게 있어.

Hollow Serenity#180.src: It... doesn't feel right leaving everything as is. Perhaps you should give Garvan and Katarin a proper burial.
Hollow Serenity#180.dst: 이대로 모든 걸 두고 가는 건... 옳지 않은 것 같다. Garvan과 Katarin을 제대로 묻어 주는 게 좋겠다.

Hollow Serenity#181.src: The telescope is pointed towards {p}... Wait. You spot something glimmering in the tree trunk.
Hollow Serenity#181.dst: 망원경이 {p} 쪽을 향해 있다... 잠깐. 나무 줄기 안에서 무언가 반짝이는 것이 보인다.

Hollow Serenity#182.src: This carcass sure is bloody, but it doesn't appear to be anything special... Who even lived here?
Hollow Serenity#182.dst: 이 시체는 분명 피투성이지만 특별한 것은 없어 보인다... 여기엔 대체 누가 살았을까?

Hollow Serenity#183.src: Looks like an odd ornament on the wall... with a hole in it?
Hollow Serenity#183.dst: 벽에 이상한 장식이 있는 듯하다... 구멍이 뚫려 있나?

Hollow Serenity#184.src: I regret to inform you that the girl has indeed perished, despite our best efforts.
Hollow Serenity#184.dst: 안타깝게도 알려 드립니다. 최선을 다했으나 그 소녀는 결국 숨을 거두었습니다.

Hollow Serenity#185.src: We have tried all the emergency plans, but none have worked so far.
Hollow Serenity#185.dst: 비상 계획은 모두 시도했으나 지금까지 어느 것도 통하지 않았습니다.

Hollow Serenity#186.src: Not even the potion that Lanis suggested did anything... We are truly lost.
Hollow Serenity#186.dst: Lanis가 제안한 물약조차 아무 효과가 없었습니다... 정말로 막막합니다.

Hollow Serenity#187.src: And if that wasn't enough, it appears that we have a runaway.
Hollow Serenity#187.dst: 그것으로도 부족한지, 달아난 자가 하나 있는 듯합니다.

Hollow Serenity#188.src: The Talor folk have been spotted patrolling the entire forest. There are no other possible explanations!
Hollow Serenity#188.dst: Talor 사람들이 숲 전체를 순찰하는 것이 목격되었습니다. 다른 설명은 있을 수 없습니다!

Hollow Serenity#189.src: We must come up with a new plan, or else--
Hollow Serenity#189.dst: 새로운 계획을 세워야 합니다, 그러지 않으면—

Hollow Serenity#190.src: The rest of the letter has been ripped off.

Hollow Serenity#191.src: Something seems off in the abandoned manor at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Hollow Serenity#191.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 버려진 저택에서 뭔가 이상한 기운이 느껴집니다

Hollow Serenity#196.src: Head to the forest village east of the manor at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and ask its residents about a man named Garvan.
Hollow Serenity#196.dst: 저택 동쪽 숲 마을 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]로 가서 주민들에게 Garvan이라는 남자에 대해 물어보세요.

Hollow Serenity#197.src: Hello soldier! Welcome to this... hick village. I presume the neighbor's kid has been stealing apples again, hmm?
Hollow Serenity#197.dst: 안녕하세요, 병사님! 이... 시골 마을에 오신 걸 환영해요. 옆집 애가 또 사과를 훔쳤나 보죠?
Hollow Serenity#197.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#198.src: Oh, Ann... Your voice is so delicate, so soothing that- Ah, soldier! Are you here for something... or someone?
Hollow Serenity#198.dst: 오, Ann... 당신 목소리는 참 섬세하고 포근해서- 아, 병사님! 뭘... 아니면 누굴 찾으러 오셨나요?
Hollow Serenity#198.speaker: Qunit

Hollow Serenity#202.src: We're the best couple in the entire forest! Nobody can match our love!
Hollow Serenity#202.dst: 우린 이 숲 전체에서 제일가는 부부예요! 우리 사랑을 따라올 사람은 없죠!
Hollow Serenity#202.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#203.src: Do you have someone special to you like we are, human? A handsome little man? Or a pretty little woman? Or... neither? We won't judge.
Hollow Serenity#203.dst: 인간님도 우리처럼 소중한 사람이 있나요? 잘생긴 남자? 예쁜 여자? 아니면... 둘 다 아닌가요? 뭐라 안 할게요.
Hollow Serenity#203.speaker: Qunit

Hollow Serenity#206.src: Yeah, what Qunit said! We've been married for {~} years! And soon that number is gonna go up to infinity!
Hollow Serenity#206.dst: 네, Qunit 말대로예요! 우린 결혼한 지 {~}년 됐어요! 그리고 곧 그 숫자는 무한대가 될 거예요!
Hollow Serenity#206.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#208.src: Oh! Sorry about Qunit, he doesn't like thinking about our... circumstances.
Hollow Serenity#208.dst: 아! Qunit은 신경 쓰지 마세요, 우리... 처지를 떠올리는 걸 싫어하거든요.
Hollow Serenity#208.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#209.src: We're in heavy debt to the government. We can't afford to live anywhere else.
Hollow Serenity#209.dst: 우린 정부에 빚이 많아요. 다른 데서 살 형편이 안 돼요.
Hollow Serenity#209.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#210.src: This forest is also safe from their prying eyes, which has inarguably caused certain... opinions to fester here...
Hollow Serenity#210.dst: 게다가 이 숲은 정부의 감시에서 벗어나 있어서, 확실히 어떤... 생각들이 여기서 곪아 가고 있죠...
Hollow Serenity#210.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#211.src: Yeah, yeah! It doesn't matter why we're here, soldier! Haha! We're here, and we love each other! That's all that matters. Yes.
Hollow Serenity#211.dst: 네, 네! 우리가 왜 여기 있는지는 중요하지 않아요, 병사님! 하하! 우린 여기 있고, 서로 사랑해요! 그게 전부죠. 네.
Hollow Serenity#211.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#212.src: Yes, actually. There's something dark to the north. There are parasites in it. It's dangerous.
Hollow Serenity#212.dst: 네, 사실 있어요. 북쪽에 어두운 무언가가 있어요. 안에 기생충이 있어요. 위험해요.
Hollow Serenity#212.speaker: Qunit

Hollow Serenity#213.src: O-oh! Don't worry about what Qunit's saying. He's been having this recurring dream of a big worm creature laying dark eggs inside of a weird cave. He won't let it go, either!
Hollow Serenity#213.dst: 어- 어머! Qunit 말은 신경 쓰지 마세요. 큰 벌레 괴물이 이상한 동굴 안에 검은 알을 낳는 꿈을 계속 꾼대요. 그걸 잊지도 못하고요!
Hollow Serenity#213.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#214.src: It's not a fantasy, Ann. I've told you this.
Hollow Serenity#214.speaker: Qunit

Hollow Serenity#215.src: Shh, honey... we'll talk about this later, not in front of the soldier... Who probably has much more important things to do, hah!
Hollow Serenity#215.dst: 쉿, 여보... 그 얘긴 나중에 해요, 병사님 앞에서 말고... 훨씬 중요한 일이 있으실 텐데, 하!
Hollow Serenity#215.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#218.src: See? We're both on the same wavelength! Neither of us have met this person! We're... so in love, darling...
Hollow Serenity#218.dst: 봤죠? 우린 마음이 딱 통해요! 둘 다 그 사람을 만난 적 없어요! 우린... 정말 사랑하죠, 자기...
Hollow Serenity#218.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#220.src: An outsider? Here? We don't get many of you people often...
Hollow Serenity#220.dst: 외지인? 여기에? 너 같은 사람은 여기 잘 안 오는데...
Hollow Serenity#220.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#222.src: The name's Aunoa. I'm a farmer. Not much else to say.
Hollow Serenity#222.dst: 난 Aunoa야. 농부지. 더 할 말은 없어.
Hollow Serenity#222.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#223.src: I've got a kid, but he doesn't live here. His mother took him away to live in {p} a while back. Don't have any other family.
Hollow Serenity#223.dst: 애가 하나 있는데 여기 안 살아. 얼마 전에 애 엄마가 데리고 {p}(으)로 갔지. 다른 가족은 없어.
Hollow Serenity#223.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#224.src: This village is the only family I have.
Hollow Serenity#224.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#225.src: It's my home. The people I know and trust live here. It's a dump, but it's still my damn home.
Hollow Serenity#225.dst: 내 집이니까. 내가 알고 믿는 사람들이 여기 살아. 엉망인 곳이지만 그래도 내 빌어먹을 집이야.
Hollow Serenity#225.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#226.src: Wish I could leave, though. This forest is awful. The crops are in horrible condition. Government doesn't give a damn about us either.
Hollow Serenity#226.dst: 떠날 수 있으면 좋겠지만. 이 숲은 끔찍해. 작물 상태도 형편없고. 정부도 우리 따윈 신경도 안 써.
Hollow Serenity#226.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#227.src: Apparently the House of Talor has a massive crypt somewhere underneath its floors. Rich people used to be buried there.
Hollow Serenity#227.dst: House of Talor 바닥 아래 어딘가에 거대한 지하 묘실이 있대. 옛날에 부자들이 거기 묻혔다더군.
Hollow Serenity#227.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#228.src: There's probably some rare artifacts down there. Go take a look if you want, but everyone here has tried and failed to find it.
Hollow Serenity#228.dst: 아마 거기 희귀한 유물이 좀 있을 거야. 원하면 가 봐. 근데 여기 사람들 다 찾으려다 실패했어.
Hollow Serenity#228.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#229.src: Yes, I do. But I probably can't stop you. Humans like you have a thing for invading privacy whenever you feel like it.
Hollow Serenity#229.dst: 그래, 신경 쓰여. 하지만 막을 수도 없겠지. 너 같은 인간들은 내키면 남의 사생활을 멋대로 침범하니까.
Hollow Serenity#229.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#230.src: And I'm too weak to stop you. You've got all of that strong gear on you, and I barely know a lick of magic. We're not on equal footing.
Hollow Serenity#230.dst: 게다가 난 널 막을 힘도 없어. 넌 좋은 장비로 무장했고, 난 마법이라곤 쥐꼬리만큼 알아. 상대가 안 되지.
Hollow Serenity#230.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#231.src: So... don't go in, but I won't stop you if you do anyways.
Hollow Serenity#231.dst: 그러니까... 들어가지 마. 그래도 들어가겠다면 말리진 않을게.
Hollow Serenity#231.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#232.src: No clue who that is. If someone like that lived here, then they're dead.
Hollow Serenity#232.dst: 누군지 몰라. 그런 사람이 여기 살았다면 이미 죽었겠지.
Hollow Serenity#232.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#233.src: Ask someone else about him if you want; I don't really care about this Garvan guy you're looking for.
Hollow Serenity#233.dst: 궁금하면 다른 사람한테 물어봐. 네가 찾는 Garvan인지 뭔지 난 관심 없어.
Hollow Serenity#233.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#234.src: Hey, you! Got any money? If you give me {~} Liquified Emeralds, I'll give you a spot of dust from the underside of my floorboards!
Hollow Serenity#234.dst: 야, 너! 돈 있어? 액체 에메랄드 {~}개 주면 우리 집 마룻바닥 밑 먼지 한 줌 줄게!
Hollow Serenity#234.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#238.src: Oh... I was... Man, I miss my glory days! I used to be a big time man, you know? I was living it up in {p}, but now I have to live in this dump!
Hollow Serenity#238.dst: 아... 난 예전에... 아, 화려했던 시절이 그립다! 나 한때 거물이었거든? {p}에서 떵떵거리며 살았는데 이제 이런 촌구석에 살아야 해!
Hollow Serenity#238.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#239.src: Damn this world! I blame them for all of this! Everything has been nothing but trouble after trouble. Now everyone can't see how much of an honest guy I am!
Hollow Serenity#239.dst: 빌어먹을 세상! 다 그놈들 탓이야! 사고에 사고만 이어졌지. 이젠 아무도 내가 얼마나 정직한 사람인지 몰라줘!
Hollow Serenity#239.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#240.src: B-BE QUIET! I don't like living here, so don't remind me!
Hollow Serenity#240.dst: 조-조용히 해! 여기 사는 거 싫으니까 상기시키지 마!
Hollow Serenity#240.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#241.src: I don't even truly have my own place! I've gotta live with some crony who owns the house I'm staying in right now.
Hollow Serenity#241.dst: 제대로 된 내 집도 없어! 지금 사는 집 주인인 웬 녀석이랑 같이 살아야 한다고.
Hollow Serenity#241.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#242.src: One day, I'll get out of here, though! I'll be a big time man again, and I'll reclaim my status in society, just you wait!
Hollow Serenity#242.dst: 그래도 언젠가 여길 벗어날 거야! 다시 거물이 돼서 사회적 지위를 되찾을 거라고, 두고 봐!
Hollow Serenity#242.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#243.src: Rumors? Do I look like a gossiper to you??
Hollow Serenity#243.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#244.src: Well, human... I'm an honest entertainer, so don't worry. Good 'ole Bip will tell you a bit of something!
Hollow Serenity#244.dst: 뭐, 인간... 난 정직한 연예인이니 걱정 마. 착한 Bip이 뭐 좀 알려 주지!
Hollow Serenity#244.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#245.src: So, apparently there's a WITCH... living in LEXDALE! OOOOOO, spooky...
Hollow Serenity#245.dst: 그러니까, LEXDALE에... 마녀가 산대! 우우우우, 무섭지...
Hollow Serenity#245.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#246.src: But the thing is, she's causing... the Decay... dun dun DUUUN!!! Uhh... I don't know, her house is decaying, or something.
Hollow Serenity#246.dst: 근데 문제는, 그 마녀가... 쇠락을 일으킨대... 두둥 두둥 두두둥!!! 어... 몰라, 집이 쇠락하는 중이라던가.
Hollow Serenity#246.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#247.src: So now, she's gonna die. The end! Didja like that story, human? Every relation to in-real life people was {~} intentional, 'cuz this is actually happening.
Hollow Serenity#247.dst: 그래서 이제 그 마녀는 죽을 거야. 끝! 이야기 어땠어, 인간? 실존 인물과의 유사성은 {~} 의도한 거야, 진짜로 일어나는 일이니까.
Hollow Serenity#247.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#248.src: Oh yeah! That's the name of the guy who FIRED ME! DAMMIT!!!-
Hollow Serenity#248.dst: 아 그럼! 그게 날 해고한 놈 이름이야! 젠장!!!-
Hollow Serenity#248.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#249.src: ...Oh, wait, no. Sorry human, I was thinking about Gavin. I don't know who this Garvan guy is! Ask someone else; I can't entertain you with that knowledge.
Hollow Serenity#249.dst: ...아, 잠깐, 아니다. 미안, 인간, Gavin 생각했어. Garvan은 누군지 몰라! 딴 사람한테 물어봐. 그 얘기론 널 즐겁게 못 해 주겠어.
Hollow Serenity#249.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#257.src: {p} apparently has something hidden inside of it.
Hollow Serenity#257.speaker: Runo

Hollow Serenity#258.src: The chains have something to do with it.
Hollow Serenity#258.speaker: Runo

Hollow Serenity#259.src: I dunno what else to say.
Hollow Serenity#259.speaker: Runo

Hollow Serenity#261.src: I just don't like talking, sheesh! My voice gets way more tense if I don't keep my words short. And it hurts.
Hollow Serenity#261.dst: 난 말하는 게 싫을 뿐이야, 참 나! 말을 짧게 안 하면 목소리가 훨씬 긴장돼. 그리고 아파.
Hollow Serenity#261.speaker: Runo

Hollow Serenity#262.src: What, are you offended? Well, I am, too! You'd be mad if some random human walked into your village and egged you into damaging your vocal chords!
Hollow Serenity#262.dst: 뭐, 기분 상했어? 나도 그래! 웬 인간이 네 마을에 쳐들어와서 성대 상하게 말 시키면 너도 화날걸!
Hollow Serenity#262.speaker: Runo

Hollow Serenity#264.src: ...You poor soul. Go buy one. Unless you're one of those guys who owns those flying land bits.
Hollow Serenity#264.dst: ...불쌍하긴. 하나 사. 저 떠다니는 땅 쪼가리 가진 녀석들 중 하나가 아니라면.
Hollow Serenity#264.speaker: Runo

Hollow Serenity#266.src: He knows most of the things here.
Hollow Serenity#266.speaker: Runo

Hollow Serenity#267.src: Huh, weird. Whatcha doing all the way out here, human? We don't see a lot of your kind often.
Hollow Serenity#267.dst: 어라, 이상하네. 이런 데까지 뭐 하러 왔어, 인간? 너희 같은 사람은 잘 안 보이는데.
Hollow Serenity#267.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#269.src: My name's Vera. I'm a farmer, but you probably already guessed that. That's all this damn village is good for anyways.
Hollow Serenity#269.dst: 난 Vera. 농부야, 뭐 이미 짐작했겠지만. 이 빌어먹을 마을은 어차피 그거밖에 쓸모가 없거든.
Hollow Serenity#269.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#270.src: I also deal with getting supplies from other towns! Pretty cool, huh?
Hollow Serenity#270.dst: 다른 마을에서 물자 받아 오는 일도 해! 꽤 멋지지?
Hollow Serenity#270.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#271.src: Uhh... all my life, actually! Too damn poor to go anywhere else, so I've just hunkered down here and decided to stick it out until I'm dead.
Hollow Serenity#271.dst: 어... 사실 평생! 너무 가난해서 딴 데 갈 수가 없어서, 그냥 여기 눌러앉아 죽을 때까지 버티기로 했지.
Hollow Serenity#271.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#272.src: It's bad, living out here, but once you get used to it some of the edge is taken off. This village is all I've really known, and I owe it to everyone here to stick around, you know what I mean?
Hollow Serenity#272.dst: 여기 사는 건 힘들지만 익숙해지면 좀 무뎌져. 내가 아는 곳은 이 마을뿐이고, 여기 사람들을 봐서라도 남아야 해. 무슨 말인지 알지?
Hollow Serenity#272.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#273.src: Still... adventuring sounds like fun, sometimes... The furthest I've ever gone from here is halfway through {p} County.
Hollow Serenity#273.dst: 그래도... 가끔은 모험이 재밌을 것 같아... 내가 가 본 제일 먼 곳이 {p} County 중간쯤이야.
Hollow Serenity#273.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#274.src: I bet you have some pretty good stories to tell from adventuring, ain't that right human?
Hollow Serenity#274.dst: 넌 모험하면서 꽤 멋진 이야깃거리가 많겠지, 안 그래, 인간?
Hollow Serenity#274.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#276.src: So, apparently... the place is actually really corrupt. They arrest innocent people every other day, and they never come back out.
Hollow Serenity#276.dst: 근데 말이야... 그곳이 사실 엄청 부패했대. 툭하면 무고한 사람을 잡아가는데, 다시는 안 나온대.
Hollow Serenity#276.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#277.src: Gavel's government hasn't done anything about it, but everyone in the forest knows damn well something shady is going on there. I'd watch myself around that place if I were you!
Hollow Serenity#277.dst: Gavel 정부는 아무것도 안 했지만, 숲 사람들은 거기서 수상한 일이 벌어지는 걸 다 알아. 나라면 그 근처에선 조심할 거야!
Hollow Serenity#277.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#279.src: Get to talking, human! You can't just leave off like that! Tell me, are the rumors about that place true?
Hollow Serenity#279.dst: 얘기 좀 해 봐, 인간! 그렇게 말 끊으면 안 되지! 말해 줘, 그곳 소문이 사실이야?
Hollow Serenity#279.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#282.src: Oh my word... and you saw it with your own eyes?
Hollow Serenity#282.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#283.src: Human... thanks for letting me know. You gotta tell more people about this, though! You could probably publish a book about it once you spread the word! You'd be rich!
Hollow Serenity#283.dst: 인간... 알려 줘서 고마워. 근데 더 많은 사람한테 알려야 해! 소문이 퍼지면 책도 낼 수 있을걸! 부자 되겠다!
Hollow Serenity#283.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#284.src: ...Well, I'm not gonna believe you if you're saying it all forced like that, you know.
Hollow Serenity#284.dst: ...음, 그렇게 억지로 말하면 안 믿을 거야.
Hollow Serenity#284.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#285.src: I won't push it, though; it was probably just too awful to talk about, right? You don't have to go into detail if you don't wanna.
Hollow Serenity#285.dst: 그래도 캐묻진 않을게. 너무 끔찍해서 말하기 힘든 거지? 싫으면 자세히 얘기 안 해도 돼.
Hollow Serenity#285.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#286.src: Just stay well away from that place, and make sure nobody else goes near there, alright?
Hollow Serenity#286.dst: 그냥 그곳엔 절대 가까이 가지 말고, 다른 사람도 못 가게 해, 알았지?
Hollow Serenity#286.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#287.src: Uh... no. That doesn't ring a single bell.
Hollow Serenity#287.dst: 어... 아니. 전혀 짚이는 데가 없어.
Hollow Serenity#287.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#288.src: You could probably ask some other people, though! I'm only the youngest guy in the village, so the older people here would probably know who this Garvan guy is!
Hollow Serenity#288.dst: 그래도 다른 사람들한테 물어봐! 난 마을에서 제일 어리니까, 나이 든 사람들은 Garvan이 누군지 알 거야!
Hollow Serenity#288.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#289.src: S-Sheesh! You scared me, human! Don't you know that you shouldn't walk into people's houses out of nowhere?
Hollow Serenity#289.dst: 깜, 깜짝이야! 놀랐잖아, 인간! 남의 집에 불쑥 들어오면 안 되는 거 몰라?
Hollow Serenity#289.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#290.src: You know there are creepy guys out here who rob people like that? You should be more careful!
Hollow Serenity#290.dst: 밖에 그런 식으로 사람 털어 가는 수상한 놈들 있는 거 알지? 좀 더 조심해!
Hollow Serenity#290.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#292.src: I'm nobody. No, I'm serious, I literally don't have a name. Parents just didn't bother to name me.
Hollow Serenity#292.dst: 난 아무도 아니야. 아니, 진짜로. 이름이 아예 없어. 부모님이 이름 붙이는 걸 귀찮아했거든.
Hollow Serenity#292.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#293.src: Apparently that's considered sacrilegious around here, so I was taken away from them and I now work for Pastor Arwes.
Hollow Serenity#293.dst: 여기선 그게 신성 모독이라나 봐. 그래서 부모님한테서 떼어져서 지금은 목사 Arwes 밑에서 일해.
Hollow Serenity#293.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#294.src: What do the others call me? Uhh... Big-nosed girl. Yeah, I know, a bit on the nose–
Hollow Serenity#294.dst: 다른 사람들이 날 뭐라고 부르냐고? 어... 코쟁이. 그래, 알아, 코 얘기라니 너무 대놓고–
Hollow Serenity#294.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#295.src: ...That sailed right over my head. But it's true, though! I have the biggest nose in the village.
Hollow Serenity#295.dst: ...무슨 말인지 하나도 모르겠네. 그래도 사실이야! 마을에서 내 코가 제일 크거든.
Hollow Serenity#295.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#297.src: I know it won't matter anymore, but sure. Call me Eua. That sounds like a nice name.
Hollow Serenity#297.dst: 이제 와서 상관없겠지만, 좋아. Eua라고 불러. 괜찮은 이름 같아.
Hollow Serenity#297.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#298.src: This one's not necessarily a rumor, but... have you ever heard of someone that they call the Wanderer?
Hollow Serenity#298.dst: 소문이라고 하긴 좀 그렇지만... 방랑자라고 불리는 사람 들어 봤어?
Hollow Serenity#298.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#299.src: He's a weird guy who just... wanders. He's completely despondent, and doesn't really interact with anyone. Even a lot of the dangerous creatures around here just tend to ignore his presence. He's almost like... a ghost.
Hollow Serenity#299.dst: 그냥... 떠돌아다니는 이상한 남자야. 완전히 넋이 나가서 아무하고도 어울리지 않아. 이 근처 위험한 생물들도 대부분 그를 무시해. 거의... 유령 같지.
Hollow Serenity#299.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#300.src: You've probably seen him before in the forest. Hooded guy, doesn't talk at all? That's who they call the Wanderer.
Hollow Serenity#300.dst: 숲에서 본 적 있을 거야. 두건 쓰고 말 한마디 안 하는 남자? 그게 바로 방랑자야.
Hollow Serenity#300.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#301.src: Well, he doesn't really hurt anyone, so I don't really worry about him too much, but still... it's spooky...
Hollow Serenity#301.dst: 뭐, 딱히 누굴 해치진 않으니 크게 걱정은 안 하는데, 그래도... 으스스해...
Hollow Serenity#301.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#302.src: Wait, THAT manor? Nah. No one goes near there anymore, not since it was abandoned. What, do you not know what happened there?
Hollow Serenity#302.dst: 잠깐, '그' 저택? 아니. 버려진 뒤로는 아무도 근처에 안 가. 뭐야, 거기서 무슨 일 있었는지 몰라?
Hollow Serenity#302.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#303.src: It used to be owned by a family of nobles called the Faltachs. Big, important people in the forest, very rich.
Hollow Serenity#303.dst: 원래 Faltach라는 귀족 가문 소유였어. 숲에서 꽤 대단한 사람들이었지, 엄청 부자였고.
Hollow Serenity#303.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#304.src: Well... a lot of stuff happened with them. The mistress of the family supposedly went insane and killed her husband at some point, or something like that...
Hollow Serenity#304.dst: 음... 그 집안엔 일이 많았어. 안주인이 미쳐서 언젠가 남편을 죽였다던가, 뭐 그런 얘기가 있어...
Hollow Serenity#304.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#305.src: There's a lot to unpack there, human. And you honestly shouldn't unpack it.
Hollow Serenity#305.dst: 파헤칠 게 한둘이 아니야, 인간. 솔직히 파헤치지 않는 게 좋아.
Hollow Serenity#305.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#306.src: Hmm... No, can't say I have. Whoever this person is, they certainly don't live here.
Hollow Serenity#306.dst: 음... 아니, 모르겠어. 누군진 몰라도 여기 사는 사람은 확실히 아니야.
Hollow Serenity#306.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#307.src: And nah, it's not me, either, even if I don't have a real name. I wouldn't even be here if my parents had named me something manly like Garvan anyways.
Hollow Serenity#307.dst: 그리고 아니, 나도 아니야. 진짜 이름이 없긴 하지만. 부모님이 Garvan 같은 남자다운 이름을 지어 줬으면 난 여기 없었겠지.
Hollow Serenity#307.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#308.src: Ask around, though! I'm sure others probably know him.
Hollow Serenity#308.dst: 그래도 여기저기 물어봐! 분명 아는 사람이 있을 거야.
Hollow Serenity#308.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#309.src: You're new... we don't see a lot of youngsters around these days... especially humans.
Hollow Serenity#309.dst: 처음 보는 얼굴이군... 요즘은 젊은이를 보기 힘들지... 특히 인간은.
Hollow Serenity#309.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#311.src: Very on the nose, whippersnapper. My name is Lokno. I'm what's left of this town during its olden days...
Hollow Serenity#311.dst: 아주 대놓고 묻는구먼, 풋내기. 내 이름은 Lokno. 옛 시절 이 마을의 마지막 남은 사람이지...
Hollow Serenity#311.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#312.src: Mhm. This village... has definitely seen better days. This Decay stuff has ruined us, just take a look around! Nothing here has been suitable for living for over {~} years...
Hollow Serenity#312.dst: 음. 이 마을은... 확실히 좋은 시절이 있었지. 이 쇠락이란 게 우릴 망쳐 놨어, 둘러봐! {~}년 넘게 사람 살 만한 곳이 하나도 없었지...
Hollow Serenity#312.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#313.src: Hah... well, right now, it's a crowd of shacks, but before the Decay came along, we used to do great...
Hollow Serenity#313.dst: 하... 지금은 판잣집 무더기지만, 쇠락이 오기 전엔 아주 잘 지냈다네...
Hollow Serenity#313.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#314.src: We always had enough food to go around, we could sell off what we didn't need to eat, and everything was thriving.
Hollow Serenity#314.dst: 먹을 건 늘 넉넉했고, 남는 건 내다 팔았지. 모든 게 번창했어.
Hollow Serenity#314.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#315.src: My great-grandmother, Aki, always told me stories about this place. Our little village. I wish I could have been around to live in it then.
Hollow Serenity#315.dst: 증조할머니 Aki께서 늘 이곳 이야기를 해 주셨지. 우리 작은 마을 말일세. 그 시절에 살아 봤으면 좋았을 텐데.
Hollow Serenity#315.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#316.src: She was always convinced though... that if the rightful rulers of Gavel returned, all of these issues could easily be squashed.
Hollow Serenity#316.dst: 그래도 할머니는 늘 확신하셨지... Gavel의 정당한 통치자가 돌아오면 이 모든 문제가 쉽게 해결될 거라고.
Hollow Serenity#316.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#317.src: To be honest... I believe the same. The government has abandoned us. So... why not bring back the old one?
Hollow Serenity#317.dst: 솔직히... 나도 그렇게 믿네. 정부는 우릴 버렸어. 그러니... 옛 통치자를 되돌리면 안 될 이유가 있나?
Hollow Serenity#317.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#318.src: I may not be the most religious villager around here, but it would feel more right to be ruled by someone who has the heavens' approval.
Hollow Serenity#318.dst: 내가 이 근처에서 가장 신앙심 깊은 주민은 아니지만, 하늘의 인정을 받은 자가 다스리는 게 더 옳다고 느껴지네.
Hollow Serenity#318.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#319.src: Nope. I don't deal with that kind of stuff, bahaha! Sorry human; you're out of luck.
Hollow Serenity#319.dst: 아니. 난 그런 건 안 해, 하하하! 미안하네, 인간. 운이 없구먼.
Hollow Serenity#319.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#320.src: G... Garvan... yes. I know that name.
Hollow Serenity#320.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#323.src: Fair warning, though... My great-grandmother is the only reason I know about him, and even then... she was always put off by him, and told me to stay away from him. I'd be wary, if I were you.
Hollow Serenity#323.dst: 그래도 경고하지... 내가 그를 아는 건 증조할머니 덕분인데, 할머니조차... 늘 그를 꺼리셨고 가까이하지 말라 하셨네. 나라면 조심하겠어.
Hollow Serenity#323.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#324.src: Or don't. He sounds like a nice man. You're strong, as well. I'm sure you'll be fine.
Hollow Serenity#324.dst: 아니면 말고. 좋은 사람 같기도 하니까. 자네도 강하고. 괜찮을 걸세.
Hollow Serenity#324.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#325.src: Investigate the contents of the abandoned laboratory at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Hollow Serenity#327.src: Return to the Faltach Manor and find the entrance to the secret study at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hollow Serenity#327.dst: Faltach 저택으로 돌아가 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]에서 비밀 서재 입구를 찾으세요.

Hollow Serenity#328.src: Uncover the secrets of the study.

Hollow Serenity#329.src: Investigate the unlocked room in the study.

Hollow Serenity#331.src: Dammit, Katarin! I'm not dealing with that loonie anymore! It's been years since I hired that scientist, and he STILL has nothing! If he doesn't find a cure soon, then I'll just get rid of him!
Hollow Serenity#331.dst: 젠장, Katarin! 그 미치광이는 더 이상 못 봐주겠소! 그 과학자를 고용한 지 몇 년인데 아직도 성과가 없어! 곧 치료제를 못 찾으면 없애 버리겠소!
Hollow Serenity#331.speaker: Yorman

Hollow Serenity#332.src: Y-Yorman, you can't be serious! What we're asking him to do is heavily unresearched, firing him for taking time on that wouldn't be a good idea!
Hollow Serenity#332.dst: Y-Yorman, 설마 진심은 아니죠! 우리가 맡긴 건 거의 연구된 적 없는 일이에요. 오래 걸린다고 내쫓는 건 좋지 않아요!
Hollow Serenity#332.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#333.src: Woman, have you SEEN the state that cretin is in?? Even if it does take long, he's in no damn shape to deal with it! Now, stop arguing with me, and help me get rid of him-
Hollow Serenity#333.dst: 부인, 그 얼간이 꼴을 봤소?? 오래 걸리는 건 그렇다 쳐도 그 상태론 감당도 못 해! 이제 그만 따지고 그놈 치우는 걸 도우시오-
Hollow Serenity#333.speaker: Yorman

Hollow Serenity#335.src: This is too far, Yorman! Garvan MUST stay! You will do this if you still love me!
Hollow Serenity#335.dst: 너무하잖아요, Yorman! Garvan은 반드시 남아야 해요! 아직 날 사랑한다면 그렇게 해요!
Hollow Serenity#335.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#336.src: ...Why do you even care so much?? Some lunatic scientist like him isn't good for anybody! We both know that we'd save more time and money by letting him run off!
Hollow Serenity#336.dst: ...대체 왜 그렇게까지 신경 쓰는 거요?? 그런 미친 과학자는 누구에게도 득이 안 돼! 내보내는 게 시간도 돈도 아낀다는 거 둘 다 알잖소!
Hollow Serenity#336.speaker: Yorman

Hollow Serenity#337.src: I still have faith in him, unlike you! I'll talk to him to see what's going on if I must, but I will NOT tolerate you throwing him out simply because you're too eager for results!
Hollow Serenity#337.dst: 당신과 달리 난 아직 그를 믿어요! 필요하면 내가 직접 얘기해 볼게요. 하지만 성과에 급급해서 그를 내쫓는 건 절대 용납 못 해요!
Hollow Serenity#337.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#339.src: ...I'm leaving to take care of some matters in {p}. Ask one of the maids to make sure that Eileen goes to bed. I'll be back before midnight.
Hollow Serenity#339.dst: ...{p}에 볼일이 있어 나가 보겠소. 하녀에게 Eileen이 잠자리에 드는지 확인하라고 하시오. 자정 전엔 돌아오겠소.
Hollow Serenity#339.speaker: Yorman

Hollow Serenity#340.src: ...That... was close... I can't have him getting between us anymore.
Hollow Serenity#340.dst: ...방금... 아슬아슬했어... 더는 그이가 우리 사이를 막게 둘 수 없어.
Hollow Serenity#340.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#341.src: I-I am here, Katarin. You wished to s- speak with me...?
Hollow Serenity#341.dst: 와, 왔습니다, Katarin. 저와 이, 이야기하고 싶으셨다고요...?
Hollow Serenity#341.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#343.src: I just wanted to check on you, love. Are... you doing alright? Is your work coming along well?
Hollow Serenity#343.dst: 그냥 당신이 어떤지 보고 싶었어요, 여보. 괜찮...아요? 연구는 잘되고 있어요?
Hollow Serenity#343.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#357.src: Ah! That is good to hear. Now then... How are things? We haven't had many chances to catch up recently.
Hollow Serenity#357.dst: 아! 다행이네요. 그럼... 요즘 어때요? 최근엔 이야기 나눌 기회가 별로 없었잖아요.
Hollow Serenity#357.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#358.src: ...Wonderful. I've met... many peers. Recently. They give me the strength I need to advance my progress. Now... how is our daughter, Eileen?
Hollow Serenity#358.dst: ...아주 좋습니다. 최근에... 동료들을 많이 만났어요. 연구를 진척시킬 힘을 주더군요. 그럼... 우리 딸 Eileen은 어떻습니까?
Hollow Serenity#358.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#359.src: She's doing great. She takes a lot after you, actually. Intelligent, beautiful, an inquisitive mind. I just hope this Decay can be dealt with and we don't need to live in fear any longer.
Hollow Serenity#359.dst: 아주 잘 지내요. 당신을 많이 닮았어요. 똑똑하고, 예쁘고, 호기심도 많고. 이 쇠락만 해결돼서 더는 두려움 속에 살지 않았으면 좋겠어요.
Hollow Serenity#359.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#361.src: Yes, it has stayed hidden. As long as it's kept intact, our souls will stay bound to it. You just need to take care of your little project and we'll ride into the sunset, just like you said, mhm?
Hollow Serenity#361.dst: 네, 잘 숨겨져 있어요. 그게 온전한 한 우리 영혼은 거기 묶여 있을 거예요. 당신은 그 작은 연구만 마무리해요. 그럼 당신 말대로 함께 석양 속으로 떠나는 거예요, 응?
Hollow Serenity#361.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#363.src: We... I will not risk her life for our love. She has a future in {p}, Garvan! She isn't a part of this, and I don't think she-
Hollow Serenity#363.dst: 우리... 난 우리 사랑 때문에 그 애 목숨을 걸진 않을 거예요. 그 애는 {p}에서 미래가 있어요, Garvan! 이 일과는 상관없고, 그 애가-
Hollow Serenity#363.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#364.src: Eileen... She is a shining star in this world. Her noble blood and natural talent makes her something truly special.
Hollow Serenity#364.dst: Eileen... 그 아이는 이 세상에서 빛나는 별입니다. 고귀한 혈통과 타고난 재능이 그 아이를 특별하게 만들지요.
Hollow Serenity#364.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#366.src: ...Forgive me, I-I'm rambling once more. I... must leave now, research calls. Goodbye, my love. Great things will happen, sooner or later.
Hollow Serenity#366.dst: ...용서하세요, 제, 제가 또 횡설수설하는군요. 전... 이제 가야 합니다, 연구가 부르네요. 안녕, 내 사랑. 머지않아 위대한 일이 일어날 겁니다.
Hollow Serenity#366.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#368.src: Make your way to Garvan's old research outpost at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hollow Serenity#368.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]에 있는 Garvan의 옛 연구 전초기지로 가세요.

Hollow Serenity#369.src: Gather as much pieces of evidence as you can in the research outpost.
Hollow Serenity#369.dst: 연구 전초기지에서 최대한 많은 증거를 모으세요.

Hollow Serenity#371.src: Ah... N-now you're finally here. I... need you, my darling. We- no... I can cure this Decay with you.
Hollow Serenity#371.dst: 아... 드, 드디어 왔구나. 난... 네가 필요하단다, 얘야. 우리- 아니... 너와 함께라면 이 쇠락을 치료할 수 있어.
Hollow Serenity#371.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#372.src: W-What do you mean...? I-I don't like this... I-I w-wanna go home. It's getting late and mother-
Hollow Serenity#372.dst: 무, 무슨 말이에요...? 이, 이거 싫어요... 지, 집에 가, 갈래요. 늦었고 엄마가-
Hollow Serenity#372.speaker: Eileen

Hollow Serenity#373.src: Ssshhh... This will only take a moment.
Hollow Serenity#373.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#374.src: W-What is that thing?? M-Mister Garvan, I-I don't understand...
Hollow Serenity#374.dst: 저, 저게 뭐예요?? G, Garvan 아저씨, 모, 모르겠어요...
Hollow Serenity#374.speaker: Eileen

Hollow Serenity#375.src: Hush, my daughter. I-I'm doing this for your s-sake... You'll t-thank me later, once it... g-grows acclimated to you.
Hollow Serenity#375.dst: 쉿, 내 딸아. 이, 이건 다 너를 위, 위해서란다... 그것이... 네게 저, 적응하고 나면 나중에 고마워할 거야.
Hollow Serenity#375.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#378.src: You... G-Garvan... Why are you here? And what's happened to Eileen? She has been sick for days!
Hollow Serenity#378.dst: 당신... G-Garvan... 여긴 왜 왔어요? 그리고 Eileen은 어떻게 된 거죠? 며칠째 아프다고요!
Hollow Serenity#378.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#379.src: Mmmm... I... Ha-a-have a bit of a... how should I phrase this... a confession to make.
Hollow Serenity#379.dst: 음... 저... 할, 할 말이 좀... 뭐라고 해야 할지... 고백할 게 있습니다.
Hollow Serenity#379.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#381.src: Y-you... Bound her soul?? Garvan, no, I told you she wasn't part of this!! WHY??
Hollow Serenity#381.dst: 다, 당신... 그 애 영혼을 묶었어요?? Garvan, 안 돼, 그 애는 상관없다고 했잖아요!! 왜??
Hollow Serenity#381.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#382.src: No, no no no no. I've done much b-b-better. She has something now. In her brain... Don't worry about the s-sorry state she's in now. The parasite will need time to acclimate to her flesh.
Hollow Serenity#382.dst: 아뇨, 아뇨 아뇨 아뇨. 훨, 훨씬 나은 걸 했어요. 그 애 안에 이제 뭔가 있어요. 뇌 속에... 지금 딱, 딱한 상태는 걱정 마세요. 기생체가 그 애 몸에 적응할 시간이 필요할 뿐이에요.
Hollow Serenity#382.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#383.src: I-I realized... a cure. My work is done, love... Eileen will be cured. The Decay can be s-stopped. It's wonderful-
Hollow Serenity#383.dst: 제, 제가 깨달았어요... 치료제를. 제 일은 끝났어요, 여보... Eileen은 나을 거예요. 쇠락도 멈, 멈출 수 있어요. 멋지죠-
Hollow Serenity#383.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#384.src: WHAT DID YOU DO TO MY DAUGHTER?? WHAT IS WRONG WITH YOU??
Hollow Serenity#384.dst: 내 딸한테 무슨 짓을 한 거야?? 당신 대체 왜 그래??
Hollow Serenity#384.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#385.src: Aaaahhhmmmm... True... I might have stepped out of line. But it's for the best.
Hollow Serenity#385.dst: 으으음... 그렇군요... 선을 넘었을지도 모르겠네요. 하지만 이게 최선입니다.
Hollow Serenity#385.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#386.src: OUT OF LINE?? This is too far, Garvan! What even happened to you?? You've been acting like this for so, so long! I-I can't take it anymore!
Hollow Serenity#386.dst: 선을 넘어?? 이건 너무하잖아요, Garvan! 대체 무슨 일이 있었던 거예요?? 이렇게 군 지 정말, 정말 오래됐어요! 더, 더는 못 참아요!
Hollow Serenity#386.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#387.src: You've changed, Garvan! I-I can't even recognize you anymore!! I'm... I'm DONE! GET OUT! STAY AWAY FROM MY FAMILY!
Hollow Serenity#387.dst: 당신 변했어요, Garvan! 이, 이젠 알아보지도 못하겠어요!! 난... 난 끝이에요! 나가요! 내 가족한테서 떨어져요!
Hollow Serenity#387.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#388.src: You again... W-What do you want from me this time...? You've... already ruined me.
Hollow Serenity#388.dst: 또 당신들이군... 이, 이번엔 또 뭘 원하는 거지...? 이미... 날 망쳐 놨잖아.
Hollow Serenity#388.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#390.src: Tell me Garvan... Where is the heir?
Hollow Serenity#390.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#391.src: I... will not tell you. I have lost Eileen and my love thanks to you. If I am to lose her... then you shall lose her as well.
Hollow Serenity#391.dst: 난... 말하지 않겠다. 너희 때문에 Eileen도, 내 사랑도 잃었어. 내가 그 아이를 잃어야 한다면... 너희도 잃게 될 거다.
Hollow Serenity#391.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#392.src: ...Lunatic. You; take him in. Keep him alive.
Hollow Serenity#392.dst: ...미치광이 같으니. 너, 저자를 데려가. 살려 두고.
Hollow Serenity#392.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#394.src: Garvan. Garvan, Garvan. I think there's a misunderstanding here. You are in no place to defy us.
Hollow Serenity#394.dst: Garvan. Garvan, Garvan. 뭔가 오해가 있는 것 같군. 넌 우리에게 맞설 처지가 아니다.
Hollow Serenity#394.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#396.src: Return to the Manor and search for any clues as to Eileen's whereabouts at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hollow Serenity#396.dst: 저택으로 돌아가 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]에서 Eileen의 행방에 관한 단서를 찾으세요.

Hollow Serenity#397.src: It seems you've arrived. F-Forgive me... I-I'm not quite used to talking anymore. It's been quite a while.
Hollow Serenity#397.dst: 왔구나. 요, 용서해 줘... 마, 말하는 게 좀 익숙하지 않아서. 꽤 오래됐거든.

Hollow Serenity#398.src: ...Nevermind. I d-don't want your forgiveness in particular. In fact, w-why do you even care? The forest has died, generations have lived on... and yet... You just had to tear the scar open, didn't you?
Hollow Serenity#398.dst: ...됐어. 딱히 네 용서를 바라는 것도 아니야. 애, 애초에 네가 왜 신경 쓰지? 숲은 죽었고, 세대는 흘러갔어... 그런데도... 굳이 그 흉터를 헤집어야 했나?

Hollow Serenity#399.src: My sins... You do not need to see them... all the things I've done wrong. H-How I destroyed the bonds tying me and my love together.
Hollow Serenity#399.dst: 내 죄... 넌 볼 필요 없어... 내가 저지른 모든 잘못을. 내, 내가 어떻게 나와 내 사랑을 잇던 인연을 부쉈는지.

Hollow Serenity#400.src: ...Y-Yes... I mean her. Katarin. She's watching us as we speak, no? A-and with that, I suppose it's obvious what lies under this veil.
Hollow Serenity#400.dst: ...그, 그래... 그녀 말이야. Katarin. 지금도 우릴 보고 있잖아? 그, 그렇다면 이 베일 아래 뭐가 있는지는 뻔하겠지.

Hollow Serenity#401.src: Greetings... I-I'm s-sure you're well acquainted with me, by now. I-It was me all along. Quite the- well, it was a predictable twist, I suppose...
Hollow Serenity#401.dst: 반갑군... 이, 이제 날 잘 알겠지. 처, 처음부터 나였어. 꽤나- 뭐, 뻔한 반전이었겠지만...
Hollow Serenity#401.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#402.src: ...B-But... I take it you don't have the full story. So... so so so so so so... Let me explain to you, human... The bitter end to our shared tale.
Hollow Serenity#402.dst: ...하, 하지만... 전말은 모르는 모양이군. 그러니... 그러니 그러니 그러니... 설명해 주지, 인간... 우리가 함께 나눈 이야기의 쓰디쓴 결말을.
Hollow Serenity#402.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#403.src: AAAAAAAGGGHHH!!!! F-FINE! I-I'll tell you... I-I'll tell y-you where Eileen is...
Hollow Serenity#403.dst: 으아아아아아악!!!! 조, 좋아! 마, 말하지... Eileen이 어디 있는지 마, 말해 주지...
Hollow Serenity#403.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#404.src: S-She... is with her mother. At the Faltach Manor. T-That is all. Just s-stop...
Hollow Serenity#404.dst: 그, 그 애는... 어머니와 함께 있어. Faltach 저택에. 그, 그게 다야. 그, 그만해...
Hollow Serenity#404.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#407.src: N-NO! GET BACK HERE! DON'T YOU DARE HARM THEM! I'LL KILL YOU!! DO YOU HEAR ME???
Hollow Serenity#407.dst: 아, 안 돼! 돌아와! 그들을 해치기만 해 봐! 죽여 버리겠다!! 내 말 들려???
Hollow Serenity#407.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#409.src: It's for your own good dear. Now, remember to stay put. Garvan won't be able to use you if you're kept inside of here...
Hollow Serenity#409.dst: 다 널 위해서란다, 얘야. 자, 꼭 가만히 있어. 여기 안에 있으면 Garvan이 널 이용하지 못해...
Hollow Serenity#409.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#411.src: Yorman won't be bothering us anymore, sweetheart. He wouldn't understand, so... J- just don't worry about what happened to him. It's irrelevant-
Hollow Serenity#411.dst: Yorman은 더는 우릴 괴롭히지 않을 거야, 아가. 그이는 이해 못 했을 테니... 그, 그이가 어떻게 됐는지는 신경 쓰지 마. 중요하지 않아-
Hollow Serenity#411.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#412.src: L-LADY KATARIN! T-THERE ARE INTRUDERS- AAAAAAHHHHHH!!!
Hollow Serenity#412.dst: K, Katarin 마님! 치, 침입자가- 으아아아아악!!!
Hollow Serenity#412.speaker: Servant

Hollow Serenity#415.src: ...Come again? No. YOU WON'T TOUCH HER! GET OUT OF MY SIGHT-
Hollow Serenity#415.dst: ...뭐라고? 싫어. 그 애한텐 손끝 하나 못 대! 내 눈앞에서 사라져-
Hollow Serenity#415.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#416.src: You're not the one making demands here... You all, search the house and find the child.
Hollow Serenity#416.dst: 여기서 요구하는 건 네가 아니야... 너희, 집을 뒤져서 아이를 찾아라.
Hollow Serenity#416.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#417.src: There she is. Hmm... it seems that the parasite injection worked well. Garvan wasn't so useless after all.
Hollow Serenity#417.dst: 저기 있군. 흠... 기생체 주입이 잘된 모양이야. Garvan이 그리 쓸모없진 않았군.
Hollow Serenity#417.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#418.src: Oh? Too terrified to speak? Worry not, Eileen Faltach. You won't be harmed... too much. You're quite important to us, you see.
Hollow Serenity#418.dst: 오? 너무 무서워서 말도 못 하나? 걱정 마라, Eileen Faltach. 다치진 않을 거다... 많이는. 넌 우리에게 꽤 중요하거든.
Hollow Serenity#418.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#419.src: N-NO! STAY AWAY FROM MY DAUGHTER!
Hollow Serenity#419.dst: 아, 안 돼! 내 딸한테서 떨어져!
Hollow Serenity#419.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#420.src: You have little choice in the matter, Miss Faltach. Stand your ground.
Hollow Serenity#420.dst: 당신에겐 선택의 여지가 별로 없어, Faltach 부인. 거기 가만히 있어.
Hollow Serenity#420.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#422.src: Tch... Some people will never understand what we do for the world. Thank you for protecting us from her, Aki.
Hollow Serenity#422.dst: 쯧... 우리가 세상을 위해 하는 일을 끝내 이해 못 하는 자들이 있지. 저 여자로부터 지켜 줘서 고맙다, Aki.
Hollow Serenity#422.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#423.src: I will deal with the heir myself. You all can head back to our village. Thank you for your help today.
Hollow Serenity#423.dst: 후계자는 내가 직접 처리하지. 너희는 마을로 돌아가라. 오늘 도와줘서 고맙다.
Hollow Serenity#423.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#425.src: DAMN IT! DAMN IT DAMN IT DAMN IT AAAAALLLL!!!!
Hollow Serenity#425.dst: 젠장! 젠장 젠장 젠장 다 젠자아아앙!!!!
Hollow Serenity#425.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#427.src: T-This will be enough. You have a wonderful grave, m-my love...
Hollow Serenity#427.dst: 이, 이 정도면 충분해요. 아름다운 무덤이에요, 내, 내 사랑...
Hollow Serenity#427.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#428.src: W-We won't be separated, though. I-I will leave our true selves here, as well.
Hollow Serenity#428.dst: 그, 그래도 우린 떨어지지 않을 거예요. 우, 우리의 진정한 자아도 여기 남겨 둘게요.
Hollow Serenity#428.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#429.dst: 내 영혼... 그리고 다, 당신 영혼을.
Hollow Serenity#429.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#430.src: T-This is our final act of love, K-Katarin... This stone will keep us here. Eternal, and in bliss.
Hollow Serenity#430.dst: 이, 이게 우리의 마지막 사랑이에요, K-Katarin... 이 돌이 우릴 여기 붙잡아 둘 거예요. 영원히, 행복하게.
Hollow Serenity#430.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#431.src: I-It's like nothing ever h-happened, right?
Hollow Serenity#431.dst: 마, 마치 아무 일도 어, 없었던 것 같지?
Hollow Serenity#431.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#433.src: N-Now you understand. T-this is... all my fault. I have ruined everything. E-everything I touched, I destroyed.
Hollow Serenity#433.dst: 이, 이제 알겠지. 이, 이건... 전부 내 잘못이야. 내가 다 망쳤어. 내, 내가 손댄 건 전부 부서졌지.
Hollow Serenity#433.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#435.src: No... You know too much. B-But I can't kill, not again. I-I can make things right. I-I'm going to fix this. I'm going to fix this. I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to...
Hollow Serenity#435.dst: 아니... 넌 너무 많이 알아. 하, 하지만 죽일 순 없어, 다시는. 바, 바로잡을 수 있어. 고, 고칠 거야. 고칠 거야. 고칠 거야 고칠 거야 고칠 거야 고칠 거야 고칠 거야...
Hollow Serenity#435.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#436.src: I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to-
Hollow Serenity#436.dst: 고칠 거야 고칠 거야 고칠 거야 고칠 거야 고칠 거야 고칠 거야 고칠 거야 고칠 거야 고칠 거야 고칠 거야 고칠 거야 고칠 거야 고칠 거야 고칠 거야 고칠 거야-
Hollow Serenity#436.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#438.src: Get to the Master Bedroom at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Hollow Serenity#439.src: K-Katarin! My l-love... is that you?
Hollow Serenity#439.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#440.src: My word... I-It is you! I missed you, love... and I'm s-so sorry... for all of this!
Hollow Serenity#440.dst: 세상에... 다, 당신이군요! 보고 싶었어요, 여보... 그리고 저, 정말 미안해요... 이 모든 게!
Hollow Serenity#440.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#441.src: I realize n-now, thanks to this h-human's efforts. What I've done has t-torn us apart... I hurt you and our l-little girl so much...
Hollow Serenity#441.dst: 이 이, 인간 덕분에 이, 이제야 깨달았어요. 내가 한 짓이 우릴 가, 갈라놓았어요... 당신과 우리 어, 어린 딸을 너무 아프게 했어요...
Hollow Serenity#441.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#442.src: I-I'm so sorry, Katarin! P-Please, forgive me! Let us f-fix all of thi-
Hollow Serenity#442.dst: 저, 정말 미안해요, Katarin! 제, 제발 용서해 줘요! 우리 이 모든 걸 바, 바로잡-
Hollow Serenity#442.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#446.src: What... What do you mean?? Speak, my love! I don't understand.
Hollow Serenity#446.dst: 뭐... 무슨 뜻이에요?? 말해 줘요, 여보! 모르겠어요.
Hollow Serenity#446.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#447.src: ...Forgiveness...? You... beg for me... to forgive... you?
Hollow Serenity#447.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#449.src: It was all my fault, from the beginning! I was wrong! W-We can fix this...! We can make everything go back to normal, j-just like it was before!
Hollow Serenity#449.dst: 처음부터 전부 제 잘못이었어요! 제가 틀렸어요! 우, 우리 이걸 바로잡을 수 있어요...! 모든 걸 예전처럼 되, 되돌릴 수 있어요!
Hollow Serenity#449.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#450.src: Please, Katarin! A-all I ask is that you forgive me!
Hollow Serenity#450.dst: 제발요, Katarin! 저, 전 용서만 받으면 돼요!
Hollow Serenity#450.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#451.src: ...You... You must really have a deathwish-
Hollow Serenity#451.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#452.src: ...Maybe I can... Forgive this. But I need something from you, as well...
Hollow Serenity#452.dst: ...어쩌면... 용서할 수도 있어요. 하지만 나도 당신한테 받을 게 있어요...
Hollow Serenity#452.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#453.src: ...Where is the gemstone? I'd... I'd like to know. And then... I could... forgive... this.
Hollow Serenity#453.dst: ...보석은 어디 있죠? 난... 알고 싶어요. 그러면... 난... 용서할... 수 있을 거예요.
Hollow Serenity#453.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#454.src: O-Oh! Is that all? Of course, my love, I can tell you!
Hollow Serenity#454.dst: 오, 오! 그거면 돼요? 물론이죠, 여보, 알려 줄게요!
Hollow Serenity#454.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#455.src: I-I placed it in the catacombs, right next to where-
Hollow Serenity#455.dst: 지, 지하 묘지에 뒀어요, 바로 옆에-
Hollow Serenity#455.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#456.src: W-What... W-WHAT I-IS THISS?? I-I C-CAN'T B-BREATHE! P-PLEASE!!
Hollow Serenity#456.dst: 뭐, 뭐야... 이, 이게 뭐야?? 수, 숨을 모, 못 쉬겠어! 제, 제발!!
Hollow Serenity#456.speaker: Garvan
